skills.name: Palm Vortex
skills.description:
Grasping the wind's might, you form a vortex of vacuum in your palm, causing continuous Anemo DMG to opponents in front of you.
The vacuum vortex explodes when the skill duration ends, causing a greater amount of Anemo DMG over a larger area.

Hold
DMG and AoE will gradually increase.

Elemental Absorption
If the vortex comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

skills.name: Gust Surge
skills.description:
Guiding the path of the wind currents, you summon a forward-moving tornado that pulls objects and opponents towards itself, dealing continuous Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the tornado comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

passives.name: Second Wind

When a character is near an Abundance Amulet, they will absorb it and obtain the following effects:

skills.name: Surgent Manifestation
skills.description:
Calling upon the might of the flora all around you, you create a Lea Lotus Lamp.
This Lamp will deal continuous Dendro DMG to opponents within its AoE.

Lotuslight Transfiguration
The Lea Lotus Lamp will undergo the following changes after it comes into contact with Hydro/Electro/Pyro:
·Hydro: the Lamp's AoE and the AoE of its attacks are increased.
·Electro: the Lamp's ATK SPD is increased.
·Pyro: the Lamp will explode after a short delay and then disappear, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
The Lea Lotus Lamp can only undergo one Lotuslight Transfiguration in its duration.

Only one Lamp created by the Traveler can exist at any one time.

skills.name: Aquacrest Saber
skills.description:
Unleashes a torrent that can cleanse the world.

Press
Sends a Torrent Surge forward that will deal Hydro DMG to opponents it comes into contact with.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode and constantly fire off Dewdrops in the direction in which you are aiming, dealing Hydro DMG to opponents they hit.
When the skill ends, it will send a Torrent Surge forward that will deal Hydro DMG to opponents it comes into contact with.
Suffusion: When using the Hold configuration of this skill, if the Traveler's HP is higher than 50%, the DMG dealt by Dewdrops will increase based on the Traveler's Max HP, and the Traveler will lose a fixed amount of HP every second.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, after using Torrent Surge, this skill will unleash a Spiritbreath Thorn that pierces opponents, dealing Pneuma-aligned Hydro DMG.

skills.name: Rising Waters
skills.description: Unleashes a slow-moving floating bubble that deals continuous Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.

passives.name: Spotless Waters

After the Dewdrop fired by the Hold Mode of the Aquacrest Saber hits an opponent, a Sourcewater Droplet will be generated near to the Traveler. If the Traveler picks it up, they will restore 7% HP.
1 Droplet can be created this way every second, and each use of Aquacrest Saber can create 4 Droplets at most.

passives.name: Clear Waters
passives.description:
If HP has been consumed via Suffusion while using the Hold Mode Aquacrest Saber, the Torrent Surge at the skill's end will deal Bonus DMG equal to 45% of the total HP the Traveler has consumed in this skill use via Suffusion.
The maximum DMG Bonus that can be gained this way is 5,000.

constellations.name: Swelling Lake

skills.name: Flowfire Blade
skills.description:
Wields a searing flame that can incinerate the very earth. Has different effects when Tapped or Held.

Tap
Call forth flames in a raging blaze. When used, the Traveler gains 42 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state, summoning a Blazing Threshold that follows the current active character.
When the Blazing Threshold gets close to opponents, it will deal Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG to nearby opponents at intervals.

Hold
Unleash fire in a composed manner, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG to nearby opponents. When used, the Traveler gains 42 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state, summoning a Scorching Threshold that follows the current active character.
When the current active character within a Scorching Threshold deals DMG to opponents, the Threshold will launch a Coordinated Attack that deals Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG based on the Traveler's ATK. This effect can occur once every 3s.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Traveler
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. The Traveler's Nightsoul's Blessing state lasts 12s at maximum, and when their Nightsoul points are exhausted, this state will end. If this Elemental Skill is used again while active, the Traveler's Nightsoul points will be reset to 42 points.
Blazing and Scorching Thresholds will disappear once the Traveler's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends, and only 1 Blazing or Scorching Threshold summoned by the Traveler themselves can exist at any one time.

skills.name: Plains Scorcher
skills.description: Condense the flames into a mark, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG to opponents up ahead. The Traveler restores 7 Nightsoul points per second for the next 4s.

passives.name: True Flame of Incineration
passives.description: When the Traveler has over 20 Nightsoul points, the attack AoE of the Blazing and Scorching Thresholds from the Elemental Skill Flowfire Blade after they hit opponents is increased.

passives.name: Embers Unspent
passives.description: After the current active character inside a Blazing Threshold or Scorching Threshold triggers a Pyro-related reaction, the Traveler will regain 5 Energy. This can occur once every 12s. Additionally, when a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, the Traveler will regain 4 Energy.

constellations.name: Starfire's Flowing Light
constellations.description: While Blazing Threshold or Scorching Threshold are active, the current active character deals 6% increased DMG. If said character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, they will deal an additional 9% DMG.
constellations.effect: While Blazing Threshold or Scorching Threshold are active, the current active character deals 6% increased DMG. If said character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, they will deal an additional 9% DMG.

skills.name: Ice Fog Piercer

Stabs at the opponent with the Traveler's weapon, which releases an ice-cold fog. This deals Cryo DMG to opponents up ahead and forms a Frostpierce Star next to the Traveler.

Frostpierce Star
· Follows your own party members around the field and periodically fires ice crystals at nearby opponents, dealing Cryo DMG.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Frostpierce Star will no longer fire ice crystals at opponents at intervals but will instead fire an ice crystal at opponents in a coordinated attack when the Traveler hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.
· When an opponent is hit with an ice crystal, the Traveler gains 1 stack of **Frostglow** (max 8 stacks).
· When not in combat, Frostglow expires after 30s.

skills.name: Frostbound Javelin
skills.description:
Generates an ice javelin with the power of Cryo, then directs it at enemies to deal multiple instances of Cryo DMG.
When cast, the Traveler consumes all existing stacks of Frostglow, which in turn increases the DMG dealt by this Elemental Burst. When 8 stacks of **Frostglow** are consumed, the number of DMG instances caused by the javelins is also increased.

**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: DMG from the current Elemental Burst is changed to Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.

passives.name: Ever-Keen Frost
passives.description: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: When a Frostpierce Star is on the field, DMG from the Traveler's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to Cryo DMG that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion, and DMG dealt is also increased by 80% of the Traveler's ATK.

passives.name: Lucent Ice
passives.description: The Traveler's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of their ATK. Up to 160 Elemental Mastery can be gained in this way.

passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Illusory Frostmirror
passives.description:
The Traveler will enter the **Radiance: Stellar-Conduct** state when inside a Polestar Field, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.35% for every 100 points of the Traveler's ATK. A maximum 7% increase can be obtained in this way.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description:
Master of Inazuma Kamisato Art Tachi Jutsu — Kamisato Ayaka, present!
Delighted to make your acquaintance.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Stability
voiceLines.description: I only wish life could be as leisurely as this a little more often... How greedy of me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Sword
voiceLines.description: A blade is like a tea-leaf. Only those who sample it many times can appreciate its true qualities.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Zoning Out
voiceLines.description: So this is a day in the life of the Traveler... Hehe, I'm learning more about you all the time.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Famous Sword
voiceLines.description: A blade embraces its duty as a jeweler cherishes their gems.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Come with me, let us find shelter from the rain.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Her Excellency... What is she trying to communicate?

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: "Snow that once adorned the world in silver, thaws to reveal the gleam of the fruit upon frost-laden branches." *sigh* How picturesque! Only some tea would make this setting more complete.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: There's a pleasant breeze and glorious sunshine... So, where shall we go for a walk?

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: Close your eyes and face the wind... It feels wonderful, doesn't it?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Oh, good morning, Traveler. ...Whenever I see you in the morning, somehow, it makes me feel like... today is going to be a good day.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Good afternoon. It is normal to feel drowsy after lunch, might I interest you in a game of Go to stimulate the mind?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Greetings. An auspicious breeze blows this evening. Tonight will be peaceful.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: "Was it one's thoughts that drew him to my dreams? Had I known it a dream, one would not have awakened." Hehe, I love that poem.

voiceLines.title: About Kamisato Ayaka: Yashiro Commission
voiceLines.description: "Inazuma Shogunate, Yashiro Commission, Kamisato Clan." Widely known as one of the most distinguished clans in all of Inazuma, it is the branch of the Tri-Commission that manages ceremonial and cultural affairs. Since my parents passed, Brother and I assumed responsibility for all clan matters, big and small.

description: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

skills.name: Favonius Bladework
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of stamina to launch an opponent using the power of wind.
Launched opponents will slowly fall to the ground.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Gale Blade
skills.description:
Focusing the might of the formless wind around her blade, Jean releases a miniature storm, launching opponents in the direction she aims at, dealing massive Anemo DMG.

Hold
At the cost of continued stamina consumption, Jean can command the whirlwind to pull surrounding opponents and objects towards her front.
Direction can be adjusted.
Character is immobile during skill duration.

skills.name: Dandelion Breeze
skills.description:
Calling upon the wind's protection, Jean creates a swirling Dandelion Field, launching surrounding opponents and dealing Anemo DMG.
At the same time, she instantly regenerates a large amount of HP for all party members. The amount of HP restored scales off Jean's ATK.

Dandelion Field
·Continuously regenerates HP of characters within the AoE and continuously imbues them with Anemo.
·Deals Anemo DMG to opponents entering or exiting the Dandelion Field.

passives.description: On hit, Jean's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance to regenerate HP equal to 15% of Jean's ATK for all party members.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I am Jean, the Dandelion Knight, requesting approval to join your party. From this day onwards, my honor and loyalty lie with you.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Operation
voiceLines.description: It's time to move on, we shouldn't stay here.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Knights of Favonius
voiceLines.description: I do hope the Knights of Favonius are all working hard...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Target
voiceLines.description: Onwards! We have work to do.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: The rain won't slow me down.

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: This weather is perfect, we should move out.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Huh, snow. Remember — tend to your boots when we return.

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: Such fine weather.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Legend has it the wind was unusually strong on that day, too...

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: A successful day starts from the morning. Let's give it our all today.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: We've still got work to do. Let's keep going.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Huh, it seems I'm immune to coffee now. Perhaps I need to ask Lisa for something... a little stronger...

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Training is finished for today. Great work, you've earned a good rest.

voiceLines.title: About Jean
voiceLines.description: Today I had no choice but to cut down five Ruin Guards to protect the people of our city... Ugh, I must continue to work harder. Though hostile, destroying such precious artifacts is still a loss to us all. I must find a less destructive way to bring them down next time...

voiceLines.title: About Us: Creed
voiceLines.description: You have my complete and full support. Of course, if your path ever deviates from justice, I will not hesitate to point it out.

name: Lisa
title: Witch of Purple Rose
description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

Hold
After an extended casting time, calls down lightning from the heavens, dealing massive Electro DMG to all nearby opponents.
Deals great amounts of extra damage to opponents based on the number of Conductive stacks applied to them, and clears their Conductive status.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Hi darling, are you going to be Lisa's little helper? What? Me, a grand mage? That was a long time ago, I'm just a humble librarian now. *chuckles* Don't worry darling, I'll take very good care of you. So...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Afternoon Tea
voiceLines.description: It's nearly time for afternoon tea.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Quest
voiceLines.description: Why not keep me company for a while... There'll be plenty of time for work later.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Better to Stay In
voiceLines.description: Today's no good for going out... Hmm... Did I say that yesterday as well?

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: *sigh* Perfect weather for sipping a cup of tea while gazing out the window.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: When I practice my spells in weather like this, I can do half the work for double the impact. Haha, I'm just teasing.

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: Such a calming breeze... Perfect for taking a nap, don't you think?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: *yawn* Good morning, Jean... Oh, it's you! Sorry, dear.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: It must almost be time for a nap...

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: You're still up? I'm getting sleepy...

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: I can see how hard you've been working today. Let me think of a way to reward you...

voiceLines.title: About Lisa
voiceLines.description: I'm not lazy, I just know to save my energy for when I need it most.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Relationships
voiceLines.description: I can be your teacher, your master, or your friend... or all three if you want...

voiceLines.title: About Us: Capabilities
voiceLines.description: Let me show you a thing or two, lest we let your efforts go to waste. *chuckles*

voiceLines.title: About Us: Ceremony
voiceLines.description: Wait, one last thing... A kiss on the forehead from master to follower. Now you're my star pupil.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Tada! *giggles* Barbara is here~ Leave the healing to me, I will not disappoint you!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Sleepiness
voiceLines.description: *yawn* All this standing around is making me so sleepy...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Encouragement
voiceLines.description: Everyone is working super hard, we should be too!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Keeping One Refreshed
voiceLines.description: Are you tired? Try my new spicy energy drink, I'm sure it'll wake you up!

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Don't stay out in the rain for too long, you'll catch a cold!

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Whoa!

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Ooh, snowflakes! Look at them dance!

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: This weather is so amazing! I could burst into song.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Don't worry! I will not... be blown away!

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning~ Let's do our best today.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Oh? You want to hear me sing...? Sorry, the show is... It hasn't started yet.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: I really want to eat some spicy squid at Good Hunter... but my stomach, er... Never mind...

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: We had a great day today! Get some rest.

voiceLines.title: About Barbara
voiceLines.description: "To the wind that guides me: When I'm exhausted, bless me with the strength to keep going forward. When I'm uncertain, bless me with the wisdom to distinguish good from evil. When I suffer from injustice, bless me with the courage to fight back..." ...Oops, my apologies, I was just doing my prayers. *giggles* You need something?

voiceLines.title: About Us: Hopes
voiceLines.description: My dream is to bring a smile to the faces of all the people in my life! As long as I can help you on your journey, I'm happy~

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Kaeya, Knight of Favonius. Please allow me to join you on your journey. Guarding you on your journey sounds far more entertaining than any of the usual Favonius stuff.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Nothing to Do
voiceLines.description: I didn't know you were such a slacker.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Knights of Favonius
voiceLines.description: Hehe, seems all the other knights already have their hands full.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Laziness
voiceLines.description: Come on, let's get moving. We're not frozen in place, after all.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Cryo is always far more effective in the rain. This is going to get interesting...

voiceLines.title: When It Snows: Anecdote
voiceLines.description: How about a ghost story to go with the snow?

voiceLines.title: When It Snows: Cold
voiceLines.description: What's wrong? Can't handle the cold?

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: What a pleasant breeze. I wonder how long it'll last?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Seize the day.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Hey, fancy joining me at the tavern for a bit?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: You're not scared of the dark, are you? That's... interesting.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Leaving already? See you next time, then. Don't make me wait too long, though.

voiceLines.title: About Kaeya
voiceLines.description: Is the Abyss Order causing you trouble? If there's anything bothering you, you know you can talk to me.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Employment Relationship
voiceLines.description: If you ever need me, let me know. Let's not make this a transaction relationship.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Strength
voiceLines.description: Oh? Well, if you're concerned about keeping things professional, maybe you can find more use for me on the front lines. How 'bout it, boss? Haha, just don't feel intimidated by what I can do.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Diluc, of Mondstadt. Not interested in idle chit-chat. If you have things you want to get done, let me know.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Relax
voiceLines.description: Guess we can rest a bit.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Knights of Favonius
voiceLines.description: You should really bring the Knights of Favonius with you next time.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Wine Guild
voiceLines.description: I still have a lot to do at the Guild. How about you take a rest while I go back?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Preparation
voiceLines.description: We should prepare while we can, then make a preemptive strike against the enemy.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Planning
voiceLines.description: Let's take a moment to rest and plan our next move.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Warning
voiceLines.description: Every course of action has its risks. Be careful.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains: Umbrella
voiceLines.description: I don't need an umbrella, but you can use one if you need.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains: Cleansing
voiceLines.description: Rain... If only it could cleanse the corrupt souls of this world.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Listen, as long as you stick to your own path, it doesn't matter what Mother Nature throws at you.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Some use the wind's whistling to drown out the sound of their crimes.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: No need for small talk. All that matters is that you were safe last night.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Would you like to try the secret menu?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Night has fallen.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Alright, see you next time. I'll make sure you leave safely.

skills.name: Claw and Thunder
skills.description:
Hunts his prey using the techniques taught to him by his master and his lupical.

Press
Swings the Thunder Wolf Claw, dealing Electro DMG to opponents in front of Razor.
Upon striking an opponent, Razor will gain an Electro Sigil, which increases his Energy Recharge rate.
Razor can have up to 3 Electro Sigils simultaneously, and gaining a new Electro Sigil refreshes their duration.

Hold
Gathers Electro energy to unleash a lightning storm over a small AoE, causing massive Electro DMG, and clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils.
Each Electro Sigil cleared in this manner will be converted into Energy for Razor.

skills.name: Lightning Fang
skills.description:
Summons the Wolf Within, which deals Electro DMG to all nearby opponents. This clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils, which will be converted into Elemental Energy for him.
The Wolf Within will fight alongside Razor for the skill's duration.

The Wolf Within
·Strikes alongside Razor's normal attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
·Raises Razor's ATK SPD and Electro RES.
·Causes Razor to be immune to DMG inflicted by the Electro-Charged status.
·Disables Razor's Charged Attacks.
·Increases Razor's resistance to interruption.

These effects end when Razor leaves the battlefield.
When Razor leaves the field, a maximum of 10 Energy will be returned to him based off the duration remaining on this skill.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: You smell... *sniff* nice! Let's hunt.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: I had a big lunch. Lots of meat. Mm, I'm happy.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Go to sleep. I watch the moon.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: You sleep now. I keep watch.

voiceLines.title: About Razor
voiceLines.description: I have no human family. I am a wolf.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Friends
voiceLines.description: You are my friend. We can hunt. Together!

voiceLines.title: About Us: Weapons
voiceLines.description: I have iron claws and teeth of thunder. I protect you.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Outrider Amber reporting for duty! Just say the word if you ever need my help!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Hobbies
voiceLines.description: I feel like running.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Longings
voiceLines.description: Jean will be upset if she catches us lazing around like this.

voiceLines.title: Chat: New Discoveries
voiceLines.description: Hey, there's something strange over there... C'mon, let's take a look!

voiceLines.title: When It Rains: Worries
voiceLines.description: Oh no, it's raining... now my uniform will get all wet...

voiceLines.title: When It Rains: Reminder
voiceLines.description: It's raining again... This will hinder our vision, we must remain vigilant!

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: Wow~ This weather is awesome!

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: If only the wind was a little stronger...

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy: Pleasant
voiceLines.description: This breeze... so refreshing!

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy: Relax
voiceLines.description: I love this kind of weather, ahh... so relaxing~

voiceLines.title: Good Morning

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Can I get lunch with you?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: It's getting late, should I light a torch?

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Agreed, getting rest is essential! Let's meet here tomorrow then. See ya!

voiceLines.title: About Amber
voiceLines.description: Mondstadt Gliding Champion, yep, that's me! Gliding Champion!

Press

Hold
Summons an even larger Wind Domain with Venti as the epicenter, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching affected opponents into the air.
After unleashing the Hold version of this ability, Venti rides the wind into the air.

Opponents hit by Skyward Sonnet will fall to the ground slowly.

Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: *Yawn* That was a refreshing sleep. Ah, Traveler, we meet again! What? You don't remember me? Ahaha, well, allow me to join you on your quest once again. I must see to it that the bards of the world tell the Traveler's tales!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Playing the Lyre
voiceLines.description: Sure, I'll play you another tune, but it'll cost you an apple.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Apple Cider
voiceLines.description: Right now I wish I was sitting at the top of a tree, looking out over a meadow, cider in hand...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Ballads
voiceLines.description: Come on Traveler, let's go! The world is full of lost ballads just waiting to be rediscovered.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Let's go jumping in puddles and see who can make the biggest splash!

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: It's stopped raining already? A shame, I wanted to play some more.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Let's wait till the snow gets heavier and have a snowball fight!

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: The wind has returned! Quick, let's go gliding!

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning! Ah... what's in store for today?

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: My tummy is rumbling, but I can't get caught pilfering food from the Dawn Winery again... Oh, it's you! Where are you heading? May I join?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Hmm, I'm still not sleepy. Fancy an evening stroll?

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Off to the land of nod? Haha, farewell, my friend!

voiceLines.title: About Venti
voiceLines.description: Practice? Me? There's no need — I already know every song in Teyvat!

voiceLines.title: About Us: New Songs
voiceLines.description: I have decided to write a song about you! What are you giving me that look for? Can't afford it? Don't be preposterous, the price for you, my friend, is precisely zero Mora! Although... one thing you could do is tell me a few more of your stories!

voiceLines.title: About Us: Heroes
voiceLines.description: Haha, once the {M#hero}{F#heroine} in the song has actually rescued the {M#princess}{F#prince}, I will ensure this song spreads to every corner of the continent!

voiceLines.description: Hello, nice to meet you! My name is Xiangling, I'm a chef from Liyue! My favorite place is the chicken... I mean, the kitchen! Ugh, I practiced so hard, but I still get nervous when introducing myself... Heh.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Snacks
voiceLines.description: Is there time for a quick snack? I'll whip one up in no time!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Pyro Slime
voiceLines.description: I can't decide whether Pyro slimes taste better with salt and pepper or garlic and herbs...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Looking for Food
voiceLines.description: If there's nothing better to do, we could go foraging for ingredients...

voiceLines.title: When It Rains: Attitude
voiceLines.description: Oh... I don't like the rain.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains: Negligence
voiceLines.description: Wait... did I leave my apron outside to dry?

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: The rain has stopped! Come with me, let's pick some matsutake.

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: Anemo Slimes always come out in this weather. If you catch some, I'll make you a Slime Slushie!

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Perfect timing! Wanna get a few cooking supplies?

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Lunch is ready! Come and get it while it lasts! *munching*

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: You're just in time for a midnight snack! I made some barbecued lizard skewers. Well, don't just stand there — dig in!

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Hey! You're not sneaking off to get a midnight snack without me, are you? ...Bedtime? Oh. Well, good night then!

voiceLines.title: About Xiangling
voiceLines.description: You've seen the dragon in Mondstadt? How big was it? What!? No way! Imagine how big a steak a dragon that huge would make!

voiceLines.title: About Us: Strengths
voiceLines.description: I'm much better at cooking than navigating... but if you do go out, definitely take me with you!

voiceLines.title: About Us: New Knowledge
voiceLines.description: Meeting you has really opened my eyes to things other than cooking. Like what? Well, such as... um... for example... I can't think when you put me on the spot! Forget it, I'll stick to cooking from now on. I have a new recipe for you to try, actually...

name: Beidou
title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

fetter.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
fetter.detail: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

skills.name: Oceanborne
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Tidecaller
skills.description:
Nothing to worry about. Should anyone raise a hand against her or her men, she will avenge it ten-fold with sword and thunder.

Press
Accumulating the power of lightning, Beidou swings her blade forward fiercely, dealing Electro DMG.

Hold
Lifts her weapon up as a shield. Max DMG absorbed scales off Beidou's Max HP.
Attacks using the energy stored within the greatsword upon release or once this ability's duration expires, dealing Electro DMG. DMG dealt scales with the number of times Beidou is attacked in the skill's duration. The greatest DMG Bonus will be attained once this effect is triggered twice.
The shield possesses the following properties:
·Has 250% Electro DMG Absorption Efficiency.
·Applies the Electro element to Beidou upon activation.

skills.name: Stormbreaker
skills.description:
Recalling her slaying of the great beast Haishan, Beidou calls upon that monstrous strength and the lightning to create a Thunderbeast's Targe around herself, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Thunderbeast's Targe
·When Normal and Charged Attacks hit, they create a lightning discharge that can jump between opponents, dealing Electro DMG.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption, and decreases DMG taken.

A maximum of 1 lightning discharge can be triggered per second.

passives.name: Retribution
passives.description: Counterattacking with Tidecaller at the precise moment when the character is hit grants the maximum DMG Bonus.

passives.name: Lightning Storm
passives.description:
Gain the following effects for 10s after unleashing Tidecaller with its maximum DMG Bonus: 
·DMG dealt by Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%. ATK SPD of Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%.
·Greatly reduced delay before unleashing Charged Attacks.

passives.name: Conqueror of Tides
passives.description:
Decreases swimming Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

constellations.name: Sea Beast's Scourge
constellations.description:
When Stormbreaker is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 16% of Beidou's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs Electro DMG 250% more effectively.
constellations.effect:
When Stormbreaker is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 16% of Beidou's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs Electro DMG 250% more effectively.

constellations.name: Upon the Turbulent Sea, the Thunder Arises
constellations.description: Stormbreaker's arc lightning can jump to 2 additional targets.
constellations.effect: Stormbreaker's arc lightning can jump to 2 additional targets.

constellations.name: Summoner of Storm
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Tidecaller by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.effect:
Increases the Level of Tidecaller by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Stunning Revenge
constellations.description: Upon being attacked, Beidou's Normal Attacks gain an additional instance of 20% Electro DMG for 10s.
constellations.effect: Upon being attacked, Beidou's Normal Attacks gain an additional instance of 20% Electro DMG for 10s.

constellations.name: Crimson Tidewalker
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stormbreaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.effect:
Increases the Level of Stormbreaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Bane of Evil
constellations.description: During the duration of Stormbreaker, the Electro RES of surrounding opponents is decreased by 15%.
constellations.effect: During the duration of Stormbreaker, the Electro RES of surrounding opponents is decreased by 15%.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I'm Beidou. You've heard of my ship, The Crux and its crew? If you too love adventure, then join me. I've got your back.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Sparring
voiceLines.description: If you ever want to trade tactics, I'm always ready.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Drinking
voiceLines.description: Ah! A cold beer after a hard day's work... Nothing like it!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Land
voiceLines.description: It's hard to remain on dry land for so long. Can never seem to quite get my land legs back.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: When stuck on a deserted island, rain is a precious source of drinking water. There's no need for it now though.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Hey, it's just a little lightning. No need to fear it on the open ocean, so there's even less need to fear it on dry land.

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: This weather would be great for setting sail.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Wind's picking up. If sand gets in your eyes, be sure not to rub them.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Yo, good morning. I'm about to head off, coming with me?

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Let's get Xiangling to whip us up something for lunch. Believe me, a hot meal from her is far better than the salted fish we eat out at sea.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Alright, I'm off for a drink. Hahaha, no one willing to sell you a proper drink, huh? Perhaps I can...

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Time moves quickly. Haha, go, may the wind be at your back.

voiceLines.title: About Beidou
voiceLines.description: We're setting sail! Men, to your posts! A new adventure is about to begin!

voiceLines.title: About Us: Titles
voiceLines.description: I'm the captain, so you can be my first mate! Deal? Ha? Such names are too outdated for you huh? We'll call each other whatever you wish then.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Eye for People
voiceLines.description: I tend to be a good judge of character. When you've learned to read the open ocean, reading people is a cinch. Haha, and that's how I knew you're the good sort the second I laid eyes on ya!

name: Xingqiu
title: Juvenile Galant
description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

fetter.title: Juvenile Galant
fetter.detail: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

skills.name: Guhua Style
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
skills.description:
Xingqiu performs twin strikes with his sword, dealing Hydro DMG. At the same time, this ability creates the maximum number of Rain Swords, which will orbit your active character.
The Rain Swords have the following properties:
·When a character takes DMG, the Rain Sword will shatter, reducing the amount of DMG taken.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption.

20% of Xingqiu's Hydro DMG Bonus will be converted to additional DMG Reduction for the Rain Swords.

The maximum amount of additional DMG Reduction that can be gained this way is 24%.
The initial maximum number of Rain Swords is 3.
Using this ability applies the Wet status onto the character.

skills.name: Guhua Sword: Raincutter
skills.description:
Initiate Rainbow Bladework and fight using an illusory sword rain, while creating the maximum number of Rain Swords.

Rainbow Bladework
·Your active character's Normal Attacks will trigger consecutive sword rain attacks, dealing Hydro DMG.
·Rain Swords will remain at the maximum number throughout the ability's duration.

passives.name: Hydropathic
passives.description: When a Rain Sword is shattered or when its duration expires, it regenerates the current character's HP based on 6% of Xingqiu's Max HP.

passives.name: Blades Amidst Raindrops
passives.description: Xingqiu gains a 20% Hydro DMG Bonus.

passives.name: Flash of Genius
passives.description: When Xingqiu crafts Character Talent Materials, he has a 25% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

constellations.name: The Scent Remained
constellations.description: Increases the maximum number of Rain Swords by 1.
constellations.effect: Increases the maximum number of Rain Swords by 1.

constellations.name: Rainbow Upon the Azure Sky
constellations.description:
Extends the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3s.
Decreases the Hydro RES of opponents hit by sword rain attacks by 15% for 4s.
constellations.effect:
Extends the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3s.
Decreases the Hydro RES of opponents hit by sword rain attacks by 15% for 4s.

constellations.name: Weaver of Verses
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.effect:
Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Evilsoother
constellations.description: Throughout the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter, the DMG dealt by Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen is increased by 50%.
constellations.effect: Throughout the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter, the DMG dealt by Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen is increased by 50%.

constellations.name: Embrace of Rain
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.effect:
Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Hence, Call Them My Own Verses
constellations.description: Activating 2 of Guhua Sword: Raincutter's sword rain attacks greatly enhances the third sword rain attack. On hit, the third sword rain attack also regenerates 3 Energy for Xingqiu.
constellations.effect: Activating 2 of Guhua Sword: Raincutter's sword rain attacks greatly enhances the third sword rain attack. On hit, the third sword rain attack also regenerates 3 Energy for Xingqiu.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Xingqiu at your service, my liege! I humbly trust that even one such as I, a mere bookworm, may yet prove to be of some utility under your wise leadership. Nice, I don't often get a chance to speak with such formality. It felt pretty good!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Night of Solitude
voiceLines.description: 'Twas on a deserted moonlit night that the hero approached the vile dragon's limpid lair...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Literature
voiceLines.description: I never embark on a journey without a good book to accompany me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Taking a Break
voiceLines.description: Now this is what I call, "a moment of solitude."

voiceLines.title: Chat: Reading
voiceLines.description: Oh my goodness... Oh my gosh... Wow— Huh? "All will be revealed in the next volume"? Aw, drat...

voiceLines.title: Chat: New Books
voiceLines.description: If my calculations are correct, Wanwen Bookhouse is due to receive a batch of new releases today. Might we add a small detour to our adventure?

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: My family makes ornate umbrellas that block neither rain nor shine. Their sole purpose is for decoration upon a wall.

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: Good, the rain has stopped. Any longer and my books would have gotten wet.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Only when it snows like this would I prefer to be at home than in a book store. For there is a well-stocked fireplace at home, while there is no fire allowed in book stores.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Great weather for practicing martial arts, but perfect weather for reading. Hey, what's that ridiculous look for? You look as if you're trying to decipher some strange text written on my forehead.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning! The morn hours are precious. Spend them on that which matters to you.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: I am uninclined to eat a heavy meal this luncheon, but instead indulge in some baked treats. As long as I eat in the study, my father and brother never have to know! Oh, you want to join me? Well... As long as you don't get crumbs on the books, I suppose it's fine.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: What say you we snatch a few fireflies and read in the light they give? Hehe... Hey, I'm joking. Seriously, don't, it's bad for your eyesight.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: You will find me in the same place as ever tomorrow. So I'll see you then. Unless you manage to get lost on the way.

voiceLines.title: About Xingqiu
voiceLines.description: I always have to put on an act around other people, because they see me only as the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild. It's a relief that I can just be myself around you. I think it's because you don't see me in the same way.

name: Xiao
title: Vigilant Yaksha
description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

fetter.title: Vigilant Yaksha
fetter.detail: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

skills.name: Whirlwind Thrust
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward thrust.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
Xiao does not take DMG from performing Plunging Attacks.

skills.name: Lemniscatic Wind Cycling
skills.description:
Xiao lunges forward, dealing Anemo DMG to opponents in his path.
Can be used in mid-air.
Starts with 2 charges.

skills.name: Bane of All Evil
skills.description:
Xiao dons the Yaksha Mask that set gods and demons trembling millennia ago.

Yaksha's Mask
·Greatly increases Xiao's jumping ability.
·Increases his attack AoE and attack DMG.
·Converts attack DMG into Anemo DMG, which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.

In this state, Xiao will continuously lose HP.
The effects of this skill end when Xiao leaves the field.

passives.name: Conqueror of Evil: Tamer of Demons
passives.description:
While under the effects of Bane of All Evil, all DMG dealt by Xiao increases by 5%. DMG increases by a further 5% for every 3s the ability persists.
The maximum DMG Bonus is 25%.

passives.name: Dissolution Eon: Heaven Fall
passives.description:
Using Lemniscatic Wind Cycling increases the DMG of subsequent uses of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling by 15%.
This effect lasts for 7s, and has a maximum of 3 stacks. Gaining a new stack refreshes the effect's duration.

passives.name: Transcension: Gravity Defier
passives.description:
Decreases climbing Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

constellations.name: Dissolution Eon: Destroyer of Worlds
constellations.description: Increases Lemniscatic Wind Cycling's charges by 1.
constellations.effect: Increases Lemniscatic Wind Cycling's charges by 1.

constellations.name: Annihilation Eon: Blossom of Kaleidos
constellations.description: When in the party and not on the field, Xiao's Energy Recharge is increased by 25%.
constellations.effect: When in the party and not on the field, Xiao's Energy Recharge is increased by 25%.

constellations.name: Conqueror of Evil: Wrath Deity
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.effect:
Increases the Level of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Transcension: Extinction of Suffering
constellations.description: When Xiao's HP falls below 50%, he gains a 100% DEF Bonus.
constellations.effect: When Xiao's HP falls below 50%, he gains a 100% DEF Bonus.

constellations.name: Evolution Eon: Origin of Ignorance
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Bane of All Evil by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.effect:
Increases the Level of Bane of All Evil by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Conqueror of Evil: Guardian Yaksha
constellations.description: While under the effects of Bane of All Evil, hitting at least 2 opponents with Xiao's Plunging Attack will immediately grant him 1 charge of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling, and for the next 1s, he may use Lemniscatic Wind Cycling while ignoring its CD.
constellations.effect: While under the effects of Bane of All Evil, hitting at least 2 opponents with Xiao's Plunging Attack will immediately grant him 1 charge of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling, and for the next 1s, he may use Lemniscatic Wind Cycling while ignoring its CD.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: If you awake to a knife at your throat, if monsters dig their claws into you, if death comes knocking at your door... Call out my name. Adeptus Xiao. I will be here when you call.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Idleness
voiceLines.description: Reduced to just standing around... How absurd.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Wandering Spirits
voiceLines.description: The damned will sooner die again than lay a hand on me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Corruption
voiceLines.description: Grrgh... Those memories, so dark...

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Demons do not stop for the rain. Move.

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: The rain stopped? I don't concern myself with the weather.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Many mortals fear lightning... Incomprehensible. Fear of something so common.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Once the snow is thick enough, we can eat it...

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: We're wasting time. Let's go.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Lunch... We'll go back to Wangshu Inn.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Night... When the darkness comes to envelop you. Don't stay outside.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Go. I'll be here.

voiceLines.title: About Xiao: Inhuman
voiceLines.description: I'm far from human. I can't make much of human emotions.

voiceLines.title: About Xiao: Liyue
voiceLines.description: Liyue is changing. Rapidly... Forget it. It means nothing to me.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Warnings
voiceLines.description: If a day comes where even you are taken by the darkness, it will be up to me...

name: Ningguang
title: Eclipsing Star
description: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

fetter.title: Eclipsing Star
fetter.detail: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

skills.name: Sparkling Scatter
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Shoots gems that deal Geo DMG.
Upon hit, this grants Ningguang 1 Star Jade.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of stamina to fire off a giant gem that deals Geo DMG.
If Ningguang has any Star Jades, unleashing a Charged Attack will cause the Star Jades to be fired at the enemy as well, dealing additional DMG.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Geo, Ningguang plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Geo DMG upon impact with the ground.

skills.name: Jade Screen
skills.description:
Ningguang creates a Jade Screen out of gold, obsidian, and her great opulence, dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Jade Screen
·Blocks opponents' projectiles.
·Endurance scales based on Ningguang's Max HP.

Jade Screen is considered a Geo Construct and can be used to block certain attacks, but cannot be climbed. Only one Jade Screen may exist at any one time.

skills.name: Starshatter
skills.description:
Gathering a great number of gems, Ningguang scatters them all at once, sending homing projectiles at her opponents that deal massive Geo DMG.
If Starshatter is cast when a Jade Screen is nearby, the Jade Screen will fire additional gem projectiles at the same time.

passives.name: Backup Plan
passives.description: When Ningguang is in possession of Star Jades, her Charged Attack does not consume Stamina.

passives.name: Strategic Reserve
passives.description: A character that passes through the Jade Screen will gain a 12% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s.

passives.name: Trove of Marvelous Treasures
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby ore veins used in forging on the mini-map.

constellations.name: Piercing Fragments
constellations.description: When a Normal Attack hits, it deals AoE DMG.
constellations.effect: When a Normal Attack hits, it deals AoE DMG.

constellations.name: Shock Effect
constellations.description:
When Jade Screen is shattered, its CD will reset.
Can occur once every 6s.
constellations.effect:
When Jade Screen is shattered, its CD will reset.
Can occur once every 6s.

constellations.name: Majesty Be the Array of Stars
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Starshatter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.effect:
Increases the Level of Starshatter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Exquisite be the Jade, Outshining All Beneath
constellations.description: Jade Screen increases nearby characters' Elemental RES by 10%.
constellations.effect: Jade Screen increases nearby characters' Elemental RES by 10%.

constellations.name: Invincible Be the Jade Screen
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Jade Screen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.effect:
Increases the Level of Jade Screen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Grandeur Be the Seven Stars
constellations.description: When Starshatter is used, Ningguang gains 7 Star Jades.
constellations.effect: When Starshatter is used, Ningguang gains 7 Star Jades.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I am Ningguang, Tianquan of Qixing. You wish to trade? You be my personal bodyguard, and I will show you how to get ahead in Liyue.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Antiques
voiceLines.description: Even if an antique is priceless, the happiness it brings lasts for only the moment that you obtain it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Trade War
voiceLines.description: In a trade war, the perfect hunter leaves no trace.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Investments
voiceLines.description: We should look for a new investment. Mora doesn't grow on trees.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Huh, it's raining. Fetch an umbrella for me, would you?

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Nothing more than regular snowfall. One day I'll take you to see the "snow" that falls over Liyue.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Calm weather? Do not trust your eyes. Your eyes can lie to you.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Gales like this can be the demise of fishermen, not to mention... Heh, never mind.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning. Report your affairs, in order of priority.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Liuli Pavilion or Xinyue Kiosk. Which would you prefer to go to for lunch?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: The tea house has no more rooms? Then come, sit in the Jade Chamber... if you can afford the price.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Sure. Go rest. If anything important comes up, I will be sure to send for you.

voiceLines.title: About Ningguang: Worldview
voiceLines.description: Be it simple price negotiation or a full-blown trade war, momentum and bargaining chips are but minor factors. To win, you need to be first to find out what cards your opponent is holding.

voiceLines.title: About Ningguang: Impression
voiceLines.description: Your impressions of me have changed? Haha, well, at first I required your strength, so naturally I had to be as cordial as possible. But now that we are partners bound by contract, we may do away with such pretentious formalities.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Rumors
voiceLines.description: I suppose you've heard enough rumors about me. Hehe... What kind of person am I? I shall leave that for you to decide... Of course, your judgment will become a part of the rumor.

name: Klee
title: Fleeing Sunlight
description: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

fetter.title: Fleeing Sunlight
fetter.detail: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

skills.name: Kaboom!
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Throws things that go boom when they hit things! Performs up to 3 explosive attacks, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Pyro DMG to opponents after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the power of Pyro, Klee plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.

skills.name: Jumpy Dumpty
skills.description:
Jumpy Dumpty is tons of boom-bang-fun! 
When thrown, Jumpy Dumpty bounces thrice, igniting and dealing AoE Pyro DMG with every bounce.

On the third bounce, the bomb splits into many mines.
The mines will explode upon contact with opponents, or after a short period of time, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Starts with 2 charges.

skills.name: Sparks 'n' Splash
skills.description: Klee's Blazing Delight! For the duration of this ability, continuously summons Sparks 'n' Splash to attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

passives.name: Pounding Surprise
passives.description:
When Jumpy Dumpty and Normal Attacks deal DMG, Klee has a 50% chance to obtain an Explosive Spark.
This Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack, which costs no Stamina and deals 50% increased DMG.

passives.name: Sparkling Burst
passives.description: When Klee's Charged Attack results in a CRIT Hit, all party members gain 2 Elemental Energy.

passives.name: All Of My Treasures!
passives.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Mondstadt on the mini-map.

constellations.name: Chained Reactions
constellations.description: Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash's DMG.
constellations.effect: Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash's DMG.

constellations.name: Explosive Frags

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Spark Knight Klee of the Knights of Favonius, reporting for duty! ...There's some more, but uh, I forgot. I'm not so good at remembering...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Spoils
voiceLines.description: Klee was a brave girl today! I found a really weird-looking lizard! Want me to show it to you?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Adventures
voiceLines.description: Do you wanna come fish blasting with me? I'll get grounded for a whole day, but it's way worth it 'cuz the fish taste sooo goood!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Rules
voiceLines.description: "Explosion inside city wall, grounded be thy woe," "Explosions can hurt people, Jean can be dreadful," "Mondstadt be bombed, Klee be doomed." Those're the survival rules that the Knights of Favonius gave me.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Mwuhahaha, lucky all my new bombs are waterproof!

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: What'd I blow up!? ...Oh wait, it's just thunder and lightning. Phew.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Dear Anemo God, please make Klee's bombs blow in the right direction and only blow up bad guys. The end.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Good morning! Can I come play with you today? Pleeeease? I wanna go on an adventure!

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Lunchtime! What do you wanna eat today? Let me see if the Teyvat Travel Guide has any suggestions...

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Good evening! Can you please tell Huffman that Klee is not a baby and is definitely allowed out to play at night? Please take me out to play together!

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Hey... Um... I know I said I don't wanna go home and all, but now it's nighttime and I can't find my way home in the dark... Can you please take me home on your way back? Pleeeease?

voiceLines.title: About Klee: Incidents
voiceLines.description: Ohhhhh... I broke one of the blades on the windmill— I'm really sorry!

voiceLines.title: About Klee: Reparations
voiceLines.description: I'm really good at fixing things though. I can help! Huh? What do you mean that's child labor? What even is child labor? Does that mean I can't help?

voiceLines.title: About Us: Knights
voiceLines.description: Hee-hee, you're an Honorary Knight but I've been a Spark Knight longer... That means I'm higher up than you, right? So you have to do what I say! So, um... Ca—Can you not say anything about the big disaster I caused? It was an accident...

voiceLines.title: About Us: Playmates
voiceLines.description: No! It's only nine o'clock, I'm staying up to watch the circus' special midnight performance! You're supposed to be my best friend! Don't even think about trying to send me home!

name: Zhongli
title: Vago Mundo
description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

skills.name: Rain of Stone
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, causing stone spears to fall along his path.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Dominus Lapidis
skills.description:
Every mountain, rock and inch of land is filled with the power of Geo, but those who can wield such powers freely are few and far between.

Press
Commands the power of earth to create a Stone Stele.

Hold
Causes nearby Geo energy to explode, causing the following effects:
·If their maximum number hasn't been reached, creates a Stone Stele.
·Creates a shield of jade. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Zhongli's Max HP.
·Deals AoE Geo DMG.
·If there are nearby targets with the Geo element, it will drain a large amount of Geo element from a maximum of 2 such targets. This effect does not cause DMG.

Stone Stele
When created, deals AoE Geo DMG.
Additionally, it will intermittently resonate with other nearby Geo constructs, dealing Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
The Stone Stele is considered a Geo construct that can both be climbed and used to block attacks.
Only one Stele created by Zhongli himself may initially exist at any one time.

Jade Shield
Possesses 150% DMG Absorption against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
Characters protected by the Jade Shield will decrease the Elemental RES and Physical RES of opponents in a small AoE by 20%. This effect cannot be stacked.

skills.name: Planet Befall
skills.description:
Brings a falling meteor down to earth, dealing massive Geo DMG to opponents caught in its AoE and applying the Petrification status to them.

Petrification
Opponents affected by the Petrification status cannot move.

passives.name: Resonant Waves
passives.description:
When the Jade Shield takes DMG, it will Fortify:
·Fortified characters have 5% increased Shield Strength.
Can stack up to 5 times, and lasts until the Jade Shield disappears.

passives.name: Dominance of Earth
passives.description:
Zhongli deals bonus DMG based on his Max HP:
·Normal Attack, Charged Attack, and Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 1.39% of Max HP.
·Dominus Lapidis' Stone Stele, resonance, and hold DMG is increased by 1.9% of Max HP.
·Planet Befall's DMG is increased by 33% of Max HP.

passives.name: Arcanum of Crystal
passives.description: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Polearm-type weapons.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: A new contract? Okay. I'm still on leave, but I can accompany you for a while. What name should I use on the contract? I have a great many names, though when on leave I tend to go by Zhongli. And you, Traveler? What name will you be signing on this contract?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Journeys
voiceLines.description: Every journey has its final day. Don't rush.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Tours
voiceLines.description: Where do you want to go next? If you'd like to see Liyue's tourist spots, I have a few references.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Liyue
voiceLines.description: Boats are made for transferring commodities back and forth, and those that come across Liyue tend to stay a while, so it is where many things come to settle.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Reminiscing
voiceLines.description: Osmanthus wine tastes the same as I remember... But where are those who share the memory?

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: Violetgrass is a plant that enjoys a moist environment and is best picked after it rains. If you should choose to pick any, be sure to store them appropriately.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: We should look for a place to take shelter. I'll be fine, but we don't want you catching a cold.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: This weather is no good for being on vacation. We should go and take in an opera.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: I hope today too shall be prosperous.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Want a quick meal to pick us back up? I know a good place in Chihu Rock.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: By this time of night, we will have already missed Ms. Yun's play, but Liyue is full of interesting places to explore, even at night.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: The market is closed and the port has settled. Go get some rest.

voiceLines.title: About Zhongli
voiceLines.description: Nothing can be accomplished without rules or standards. No matter if it is mortals or adepti, everyone has their place. This rule is what keeps Liyue in peace.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Gold
voiceLines.description: Gold is Liyue's treasure. It is the blood that runs through her heart. As for whether your own heart shines like gold — we will have to wait and see.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Contracts
voiceLines.description: You and I have a contract, so feel free to discuss anything at all within the scope of said contract.

title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!

skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the dark lightning spirits of Immernachtreich shall heed the call of their Prinzessin and indwell the enchanted arrowhead. When fully indwelt, the Rachsüchtig Blitz shall deal immense Electro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Nightrider
skills.description:
Summons Oz. The night raven forged of darkness and lightning descends upon the land, dealing Electro DMG in a small AoE.
For the ability's duration, Oz will continuously attack nearby opponents with Freikugel.

Hold to adjust the location Oz will be summoned to.
Press again any time during the ability's duration to once again summon him to Fischl's side.

skills.name: Midnight Phantasmagoria
skills.description:
Summons Oz to spread his twin wings of twilight and defend Fischl.
Has the following properties during the ability's duration:
·Fischl takes on Oz's form, greatly increasing her Movement Speed.
·Strikes nearby opponents with lightning, dealing Electro DMG to opponents she comes into contact with. Each opponent can only be struck once.
·Once this ability's effects end, Oz will remain on the battlefield and attack his Prinzessin's foes. If Oz is already on the field, then this will reset the duration of his presence.

passives.name: Stellar Predator
passives.description: When Fischl hits Oz with a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Oz brings down Thundering Retribution, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 152.7% of the arrow's DMG.

passives.name: Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex
passives.description: If your current active character triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction when Oz is on the field, the opponent shall be stricken with Thundering Retribution that deals Electro DMG equal to 80% of Fischl's ATK.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description:
Fischl: I, Fischl, Prinzessin der Verurteilung, descend upon this land by the call of fate an— Oh, you are also a traveler from another world? Very well, I grant you permission to travel with me.
Oz: She means, "Nice to meet you."

voiceLines.title: Chat: Whispers of Destiny
voiceLines.description: I hear the voice of fate, speaking my name in humble supplication...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Creation of the World
voiceLines.description: Hm-hm, may the glory of the Prinzessin bring light to this world.

voiceLines.title: Chat: One From the Beyond
voiceLines.description:
Fischl: I do worry about the well-being of my retinue during my impromptu absence...
Oz: I'm sure the good people of the Adventurers' Guild are absolutely fine, mein Fräulein.

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: Oh, the sun's out— Oh, um... This meteorological transformation is most splendid! Like a felicitous twist of fate in the face of certain doom.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description:
Fischl: Hark! 'Tis Thundering Retribution, an omen of dark times ahead...
Oz: That, and mein Fräulein's laundry is still on the line...
Fischl: Wha... Seriously!?

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description:
Fischl: A wonderful sight indeed. Why, it reminds me of my home world, where at the sight of the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, the very blood and tears of sinners turn to ice! ...Achoo! Achoo!
Oz: Not only their blood and tears, but also their saliva and mucus, mein Fräulein.
Fischl: Oz— Ahh—Achoo!!!

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description:
Fischl: Ozzie, my dear familiar...
Oz: "Ozzie?" What's gotten into you...
Fischl: Her Majesty beseeches you to unfurl your blessèd wings, and with them blot out the heavens, plunging the world into eternal night...
Oz: If you didn't bring your parasol with you, that's your own fault, mein Fräulein!

voiceLines.title: Good Morning: Greet Fischl
voiceLines.description: Dusk and dawn but fleeting shadows are. Once more, the twists of fate have led you into my everlasting night.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning: Greet Oz
voiceLines.description:
Oz: Good morning. Mein Fräulein heard you'd be dropping by, so she's preparing breakfast.
Fischl: Oz! ...Ahem. To what do I owe the pleasure?

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Even one of royal blood finds oneself susceptible to drowsiness at this hour.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description:
Fischl: The stars of firmament are naught but rifts, thrust open by Oz's beak into the boundless tapestry of darkness.
Oz: You do say the strangest things, mein Fräulein.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description:
Fischl: Sweet shall be thy sleep, spared of the Mares of the Night! For no Night-Mares would dare draw near to those who are blessed by the Immernachtreich!
Oz: She means, "Goodnight."

voiceLines.title: About Fischl: Prinzessin der Verurteilung
voiceLines.description:
Fischl: Me? Hehehe. Remember thou this, that I, Fischl, am the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, Sovereign of Immernachtreich, omniscient and eminent judge of all the world's iniquity!
Oz: She's an investigator for the Adventurers' Guild.
Fischl: ...Ahem. That is but one of my many royal engagements.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Beings Who Descended Upon This World
voiceLines.description: Huh, you and I are both travelers from another world. That our paths have crossed here is no accident, but the will of fate.

description: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

skills.name: Strike of Fortune
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Passion Overload
skills.description:
Bennett puts all his fire and passion for adventuring into his sword. Results may vary based on how fired up he is...

Press
A single, swift flame strike that deals Pyro DMG.

Hold (Short)
Charges up, resulting in different effects when unleashed based on the Charge Level.
·Level 1: Strikes twice, dealing Pyro DMG and launching opponents.
·Level 2: Unleashes 3 consecutive attacks that deal impressive Pyro DMG, but the last attack triggers an explosion that launches both Bennett and the enemy.
Bennett takes no damage from being launched.

skills.name: Fantastic Voyage
skills.description:
Bennett performs a jumping attack that deals Pyro DMG, creating an Inspiration Field.

Inspiration Field
·If the health of a character within the AoE is equal to or falls below 70%, their health will continuously regenerate. The amount of HP restored scales off Bennett's Max HP.
·If the health of a character within the AoE is higher than 70%, they gain an ATK Bonus that is based on Bennett's Base ATK.
·Imbues characters within the AoE with Pyro.

passives.name: Rekindle
passives.description: Decreases Passion Overload's CD by 20%.

passives.name: Fearnaught

Within the area created by Fantastic Voyage, Passion Overload takes on the following effects:
·CD is reduced by 50%.
·Bennett will not be launched by the effects of Charge Level 2.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: This is your team? Cool... I like the vibe. I'm Bennett, leader of Benny's Adventure Team. Any chance we can team up? Please?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Treasures
voiceLines.description: Let's go find some treasure!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Adventures
voiceLines.description: No one's joined me on an adventure in ages. C'mon, let's go!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Self-Deprecation
voiceLines.description: "Good things come to those who don't wait around!" That's what they say, anyway. Knowing my luck, the opposite is probably true for me...

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: It always rains when I go on an adventure.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Don't stand too close to me, or you might get hit by lightning too.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Weather's not bad today... Oh crud, I jinxed it! Now it's bound to rain.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Careful! In this kind of wind, it's easy to get hit in the head by flying rocks.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning! Where's the adventure at today?

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: I brought a sandwich. You want some? I'll give you hal- *choking* *spluttering* ...Phew. Sorry, nearly choked to death there!

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Hey, wanna go talk to my dads for a bit? They tell the best adventure stories!

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: You're headed off? Cool. It was awesome adventuring with you. We should totally do it again!

voiceLines.title: About Bennett: Adventure Team
voiceLines.description: I'm the leader of Benny's Adventure Team — a rising star in the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild! ...Where are the others? Ah, haha, they're all on leave right now.

voiceLines.title: About Bennett: Bad Luck
voiceLines.description: Eh, it's not as bad as you've heard! Everyone falls into a trapper's pit or gets hit on the head by a falling tree now and then, right?

voiceLines.title: About Us: Teammates
voiceLines.description: Hahaha, you wish! Benny's Adventure Team has had no vacancies in ages... I mean, you must be spoiled for choice, right? Why'd you wanna join the unluckiest adventurer alive, anyway?

name: Tartaglia
title: Childe
description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.
