skills.name: Cutting Torrent
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Hydro will accumulate on the arrowhead. An arrow fully charged with the torrent will deal Hydro DMG and apply the Riptide status.

Riptide
Opponents affected by Riptide will suffer from AoE Hydro DMG effects when attacked by Tartaglia in various ways. DMG dealt in this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
·Riptide Flash: A fully-charged Aimed Shot that hits an opponent affected by Riptide deals consecutive bouts of AoE DMG. Can occur once every 0.7s.
·Riptide Burst: Defeating an opponent affected by Riptide creates a Hydro burst that inflicts the Riptide status on nearby opponents hit.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
When Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, he cannot perform a plunging attack.

skills.name: Foul Legacy: Raging Tide
skills.description:
Unleashes a set of weaponry made of pure water, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and entering Melee Stance.
In this Stance, Tartaglia's Normal and Charged Attacks are converted to Hydro DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion and change as follows:

Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive Hydro strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a cross slash, dealing Hydro DMG.

Riptide Slash
Hitting an opponent affected by Riptide with a melee attack unleashes a Riptide Slash that deals AoE Hydro DMG. DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG, and can only occur once every 1.5s.

After 30s, or when the ability is unleashed again, this skill will end. Tartaglia will return to his Ranged Stance and this ability will enter CD. The longer Tartaglia stays in his Melee Stance, the longer the CD.
If the return to a ranged stance occurs automatically after 30s, the CD is even longer.

skills.name: Havoc: Obliteration
skills.description:
Performs different attacks based on what stance Tartaglia is in when casting.

Ranged Stance: Flash of Havoc
Swiftly fires a Hydro-imbued magic arrow, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and applying the Riptide status.
Returns a portion of its Energy Cost after use.

Melee Stance: Light of Obliteration

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I'm No. 11 of the Fatui Harbingers, codename Childe, but I also go by Tartaglia. And you... Hmm, you too like to cause quite the stir, don't you? Something tells me we're going to get along splendidly.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Idleness
voiceLines.description: You know, there are better ways to seek out our enemies than... well, standing here.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Test of Skills
voiceLines.description: This place is pretty dead... By which I mean, there's nothing to kill.

voiceLines.title: Chat: The Fatui
voiceLines.description: I wonder what the rest of the Harbingers are up to? Plotting and scheming on an ever-grander scale, no doubt.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Snezhnaya
voiceLines.description: Where I'm from, if we didn't keep moving, we'd freeze to death. Literally.

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: Ah, perfect weather for fishing! The sound of the rain scares them away, but once it stops, they're yours for the taking.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows: Foreign Country
voiceLines.description: Haha, ahh... could it be snowing in Snezhnaya too?

voiceLines.title: When It Snows: Snezhnaya
voiceLines.description: The world looks glorious in the snow. Pure white, like the light of the moon. A perfect backdrop for bloodshed.

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: The wind is picking up. There is conflict in the air.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing: Foreign Country
voiceLines.description: Just look at that wind blow!

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing: Snezhnaya
voiceLines.description: The wind permeates all, cleansing both mind and body. Excellent.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning, comrade! You're raring to go today, I see.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: You look well. What's your secret? Care to exchange notes?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Whew, dinner was quite the feast. A spot of exercise is in order.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Today was great. See you tomorrow, comrade!

name: Noelle
title: Chivalric Blossom
description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

fetter.title: Chivalric Blossom

skills.name: Favonius Bladework - Maid
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Breastplate
skills.description:
Summons protective stone armor, dealing Geo DMG to surrounding opponents and creating a shield. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Noelle's DEF.
The shield has the following properties:
·When Noelle's Normal and Charged Attacks hit a target, they have a certain chance to regenerate HP for all characters.
·Possesses 150% DMG Absorption efficiency against all Elemental and Physical DMG.

The amount of HP healed when regeneration is triggered scales based on Noelle's DEF.

skills.name: Sweeping Time
skills.description:
Gathering the strength of stone around her weapon, Noelle strikes the opponents surrounding her within a large AoE, dealing Geo DMG.
Afterwards, Noelle gains the following effects:
·Larger attack AoE.
·Converts attack DMG to Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Increased ATK that scales based on her DEF.

passives.name: Devotion
passives.description:
When Noelle is in the party but not on the field, this ability triggers automatically when your active character's HP falls below 30%:
Creates a shield for your active character that lasts for 20s and absorbs DMG equal to 400% of Noelle's DEF.
The shield has a 150% DMG Absorption effectiveness against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
This effect can only occur once every 60s.

passives.name: Nice and Clean
passives.description:
Noelle will decrease the CD of Breastplate by 1s for every 4 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores on opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.

passives.name: Maid's Knighthood
passives.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a DEF-boosting dish, Noelle has a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

constellations.effect: While Sweeping Time and Breastplate are both in effect, the chance of Breastplate's healing effects activating is increased to 100%.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: My name is Noelle, maid of the Knights of Favonius, and it's my pleasure to be joining you on your adventure today. Should you encounter any problems at all at any point throughout your journey, please do not hesitate to call me and I will be delighted to provide you with my full assistance. Yes, starting right now — what do you need?

voiceLines.title: Chat: A Favor
voiceLines.description: Leave it to me! All of it, whatever it is! ...What... exactly is "it"? I didn't quite catch your request...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Rest
voiceLines.description: You seem tired. Would you like some tea? I'll brew you some. Do you take sugar? One cube, or two?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Being Reliable
voiceLines.description: Whenever you need me, I'll be there.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Oh dear, everyone's laundry is still on the line! May I be excused to fetch it in?

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Please stay indoors until the storm passes. I will deal with any urgent outdoor business.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Mmm, such fair weather. Why don't we do a bit of sunny work? Oh, what sort of work is that, you ask? Haha, well, anything that makes you feel bright and sunny too.

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: Ahh... Can you hear the Anemo Archon's voice on the breeze? It calms me down whenever I get flustered.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Good morning! Breakfast is served. I will be on hand the whole time. Should you find that anything is not to your taste, please, do not hesitate to let me know.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Ready for your tea break? Please wait here while I get it ready. Oh yes, I also made Lighter-Than-Air Pancakes! You simply must try one, it's my specialty.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Everyone has free time in the evening, and that is when I am busiest. Where have Amber's washed hairbands been placed? How many new eyepatches did Kaeya buy? Keeping track of all these things is a maid's responsibility.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Please get some rest, you must be tired from today's adventure. I should head back to the Knights of F— Sorry? You want me to watch over you until you fall asleep? I—I... I mean, of course, it's no problem. But, um... You're not just teasing me, are you?

voiceLines.title: About Noelle: Discipline
voiceLines.description: In my job, I do the exact same things every day — a far cry from being a true knight, that's for sure. But ultimately, this is all part of my training, and when it comes to training, actions speak louder than words.

voiceLines.title: About Noelle: Disagreement
voiceLines.description: I'm a bit useless in an argument because I can't really explain my reasoning clearly. People find that hard to understand, so instead, I try to just get on with my work in my own way. But then they call me stubborn. All I try to do is convince people with results instead of trying to talk them round... Is that really stubborn of me?

voiceLines.title: About Us: Identities
voiceLines.description: I am devoted to what I do, but make no mistake — I devote myself freely. A maid, to me, is the most liberating job there is. I'm a chef, a gardener, a warrior, a guide... I can be anything you need me to be!

name: Qiqi
title: Icy Resurrection
description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

Herald of Frost

·Periodically regenerates your active character's HP.
·Follows the character around, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in their path.

Fortune-Preserving Talisman
When opponents affected by this Talisman take DMG, the character that dealt this DMG regenerates HP.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I am Qiqi. I am a zombie. And I... forgot what comes next.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Talking to Herself
voiceLines.description: Hey, do you know what? Uhh... neither do I. I... already forgot.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Afraid of Heat
voiceLines.description: Let's go somewhere cooler.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Training
voiceLines.description: One, two, three, four. Two, two, three, four...

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: I forgot my umbrella again.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: I want to build a snowman. Will you help?

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: I should have stayed indoors today.

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: The wind is... frigid. I like it.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Hold my hand please. This wind could blow me away.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning means it's time to check my diary. Because my diary reminds me what I'm supposed to do in the morning.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: I just remembered something. I forgot to help Dr. Baizhu prepare medications.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Good evening. How was your day? My day was... fine, I think. But I can't remember.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: It's time for you to sleep now. I will do my stretches. ...Do not watch me, please.

voiceLines.title: About Qiqi
voiceLines.description: Did you ask me something? Sorry... I forgot.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Memory
voiceLines.description: I have a poor memory for most things. But as far as I know, that doesn't matter.

title: Frozen Ardor
description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

Performing the secret hand seals, Chongyun summons 3 giant spirit blades in mid-air that fall to the earth one by one after a short delay, exploding as they hit the ground.
When the spirit blades explode, they will deal AoE Cryo DMG and launch opponents.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: My name is Chongyun. My family has practiced the art of exorcism in Liyue for many generations. Fate has been generous in allowing my path to cross with that of your distinguished self. ...Oh, no — my services are free of charge!

voiceLines.title: Chat: The Art of Exorcism
voiceLines.description: Exorcism uses thaumaturgy and martial arts to conquer evil. There are other means to the same end, but they are not the true way.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Diet
voiceLines.description: I take my meals cold to quiet the spirit and calm my vital energies. Qingxin-infused water with ice is the most effective.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Mantras
voiceLines.description: "Heart be pure, evil be erased. Mind be purged, world be..." Um... Ugh, I always forget that last part.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: There is no purer form of water than rain. It can aid us greatly in the purging of evil.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Before the resounding thunder, evil must cower in fear.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Ah, this weather is delightful.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: It is unwise to waste the precious morning hours. Time to train!

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: One's spiritual energies are at their peak at noon. We must take that time to practice.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: As the day winds down and the quiet of evening sets in, the atmosphere is ripe for focusing your mind. There is no better time than this for training.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Whew. What a tiring day. You should get some rest. Don't forget what we agreed — we will investigate that haunted house tomorrow.

voiceLines.title: About Chongyun: Exorcists
voiceLines.description: We exorcists have been protectors of Liyue since ancient times, and our techniques have been passed down from generation to generation. Purging evil is second nature to us.

voiceLines.title: About Chongyun: Commissions
voiceLines.description: *sigh* I didn't actually do anything. I just walked into that haunted house, and the problem was resolved... Do you think I should still take payment for this exorcism?

voiceLines.title: About Us: Companions
voiceLines.description: Your skills are impressive. When you finish with a hilichurl— I mean, an evil spirit, it is surely banished from this world for good. How about we team up?

voiceLines.title: About Us: Ghost Stories
voiceLines.description: By now, you must be well acquainted with Liyue's supernatural phenomena. Now, about the evil beings you speak of in lands beyond... I would very much like to see them too.

name: Ganyu
title: Plenilune Gaze
description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

fetter.title: Plenilune Gaze

skills.name: Liutian Archery
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, an icy aura will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off an icy arrow that deals Cryo DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Fires off a Frostflake Arrow that deals Cryo DMG. The Frostflake Arrow blooms after hitting its target, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Trail of the Qilin
skills.description:
Leaving a single Ice Lotus behind, Ganyu dashes backward, shunning all impurity and dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

Ice Lotus
·Continuously taunts surrounding opponents, attracting them to attack it.
·Endurance scales based on Ganyu's Max HP.
·Blooms profusely when destroyed or once its duration ends, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

skills.name: Celestial Shower
skills.description:
Coalesces atmospheric frost and snow to summon a Sacred Cryo Pearl that exorcises evil.
During its ability duration, the Sacred Cryo Pearl will continuously rain down shards of ice, striking opponents within an AoE and dealing Cryo DMG.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Copy that! Here is a draft Service Agreement for your review and consideration. Effective immediately, if all is in order... Ah! Wait a sec, wait a sec, I forgot to sign it... Gan... Yu... There. Right. Now... What was it you needed me to do for you exactly?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Relaxed
voiceLines.description: It's so nice to de-stress.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Attentive
voiceLines.description: If you lie on the grass, you can feel the heartbeat of the world.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Anxious
voiceLines.description: Should we really be off work this early? There is still a lot left to do...

voiceLines.title: When It Rains: Worries
voiceLines.description: Oh good! I was just thinking that the Silk Flowers at the Feiyun Commerce Guild needed watering. The transport co-ordinators will probably moan about the muddy mountain roads again, though...

voiceLines.title: When It Rains: Listening to the Rain
voiceLines.description: It is something of a luxury, but I love listening to the rain from the courtyard.

voiceLines.title: After the Rain
voiceLines.description: Oh, the sun's out. When did that happen?

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Ah, the air is just right.

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: Ah, I love the smell of Glaze Lilies.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning! What's wrong, is there something stuck in my hair? ...Oh. Please don't stare at my h—hairpiece.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: *yawn* Ugh... I need a nap. If there aren't any urgent matters, I'll excuse myself.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Look how brightly lit the city is at night! Amazing. I wonder what it's like for all the people down there... Hmm? Umm... No thanks, I think I'll pass on the night market. Sorry...

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: May Rex Lapis watch over you. May your dreams be peaceful and sweet.

voiceLines.title: About Ganyu
voiceLines.description: My job is to honor my contract with Rex Lapis by looking out for the interests of all living things in Liyue.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Work
voiceLines.description: I finished all my assignments early today. ...O—Overtime? I understand. I'll get right on the case.

skills.name: Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma
skills.description:
Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma using alchemy, which deals AoE Geo DMG on appearance.

Solar Isotoma
has the following properties:
·When opponents within the Solar Isotoma field take DMG, the Solar Isotoma will generate Transient Blossoms which deal AoE Geo DMG. DMG dealt scales off Albedo's DEF. 
·Transient Blossoms can only be generated once every 2s.
·When a character is located at the locus of the Solar Isotoma, the Solar Isotoma will accumulate Geo power to form a crystallized platform that lifts the character up to a certain height. Only one crystallized platform can exist at a time.
·Solar Isotoma is considered a Geo construct. Only one Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself can exist at a time. 

Hold to designate the location of the skill.

skills.name: Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide
skills.description:

If a Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself is on the field, 7 Fatal Blossoms will be generated in the Solar Isotoma field, bursting violently into bloom and dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Tectonic Tide DMG and Fatal Blossom DMG will not generate Transient Blossoms.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I am Albedo, Chief Alchemist of the Knights of Favonius. You carry the aura of the stars, interesting... I would like to study you, if you do not mind. I'm certain we will have many opportunities to be alone in the future.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Still Life
voiceLines.description: What a view... How about a quick break so I can sketch this beautiful scenery?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Investigation
voiceLines.description: "The truth of this world"... *sigh* What could it be?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Reminiscing
voiceLines.description: Going out into the world and investigating, turning the "unknown" into the "known." ...Ahhh, I missed this feeling.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: The soil is moist, ideal for collecting the roots of Boom Blossoms. No please, allow me to handle this.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Master...

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Ample light... active biological organisms... Yes, this is a good place to sketch.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Good morning. Are we going to search for ancient relics today?

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Good afternoon. I heard your footsteps. My, it certainly is lively outside of the workshop.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: *sigh* It's gotten quiet outside...

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Good night, you go ahead and rest. I will just finish one last experiment before bed... If you are interested in the results, I can discuss them with you tomorrow.

voiceLines.title: About Albedo: Genius
voiceLines.description: Genius? ...A number of people call me that. But I don't think I'm any "genius."

voiceLines.title: About Albedo: Socializing
voiceLines.description: Relationships are... *sigh* quite troublesome. Once you establish a relation with someone, you must continue to maintain it; if you lose contact, you must reestablish the relation. This taxing cycle requires...a lot of time.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Experiments
voiceLines.description:
You... want to accompany me while I experiment? I'm honored.
Oh, don't be nervous. My experiments may be dangerous, but no one gets hurt... most of the time.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Assistant
voiceLines.description: Would you oblige me by serving as my assistant? After observing so many experiments, you surely know a good deal about alchemy by now. Relax, we will work together. I don't think you will have any problems. I have faith in my ability to instruct you, and even more faith in your exceptional talents.

Hold
Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws.
The shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus.

The shield has a 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by Cryo at the point of formation for a short duration.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Diona, bartender of the Cat's Tail! I charge a hefty fee for private events. Huh? You didn't come here for a drink? Hmm... Then I accept your invitation... I suppose...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Relax
voiceLines.description: Ahhh... that stretch feels good.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Thinking
voiceLines.description: Hmm. Lizard Tail, Pepper, Starconch, hmm... what else do I need to create the most dreadfully disgusting cocktail?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Waiting
voiceLines.description: I—I wasn't waiting for you. I just happened to be resting!

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Rain! I hate rain! ...Let's go inside... I—I'm not scared of water, I just... hate it when my clothes get wet.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Ahh!!! Uhh, um... I'm not shaking, I'm not... Ohhhh...

voiceLines.title: When It Snows: Playtime
voiceLines.description: Ooh, it's so cold to touch. Wow, it's so much fun!

voiceLines.title: When It Snows: Viewing
voiceLines.description: Ooooh, look at the little white snowflakes dancing in the wind, to and fro, and... whew, isn't it... beautiful! C'mon, c'mon c'mon, sit with me... Watch...

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Come on, let's go bask in the sun a bit~ ...If you aren't coming, I'll just go by myself~ ...Last chance! Are you coming or not!?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning~ Can you hand me that can of salted loach from the cabinet? Time to destroy the wine industry!

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon: Strange Noises
voiceLines.description: Wha— Ugh, no! You heard nothing!

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon: Canned Food
voiceLines.description: Uh, I was saving this can of fish for when I was really hungry. Stop looking at it like that! ...Mmm, okay, I'll let you have a little taste, but nothing more!

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Aw, I failed... Ugh, again... Everyone loved my drinks! Gah... Don't try to comfort me. I—I don't need comforting!

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Without cat vision, will you be okay walking home in the dark? If you need me to escort you... What? Th—There's lights? Pff, well who said anything about escorting you? Go on now.

voiceLines.title: About Diona
voiceLines.description: My ears and tail are no prop, they're real. Proof of my Kätzlein bloodline. It's only weird to you cause you've never seen it before. Wh—Why are you looking at me like that? Fine. You can touch my ears for a second, but the tail is off limits!

name: Mona
title: Astral Reflection
description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Hydro, Mona plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.

skills.name: Mirror Reflection of Doom
skills.description:
Creates an illusory Phantom of Fate from coalesced waterspouts.

Phantom
Has the following special properties:
·Continuously taunts nearby opponents, attracting their fire.
·Continuously deals Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
·When its duration expires, the Phantom explodes, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

Hold
Utilizes water currents to move backwards swiftly before conjuring a Phantom.

Only one Phantom created by Mirror Reflection of Doom can exist at any time.

skills.name: Stellaris Phantasm
skills.description:
Mona summons the sparkling waves and creates a reflection of the starry sky, applying the Illusory Bubble status to opponents in a large AoE.

Illusory Bubble
Traps opponents inside a pocket of destiny and also makes them Wet. Renders weaker opponents immobile.
When an opponent affected by Illusory Bubble sustains DMG, it has the following effects:
·Applies an Omen to the opponent, which gives a DMG Bonus, also increasing the DMG of the attack that causes it.
·Removes the Illusory Bubble, dealing Hydro DMG in the process.

Omen
During its duration, increases DMG taken by opponents.

skills.name: Illusory Torrent
skills.description:
Alternate Sprint
Mona cloaks herself within the water's flow, consuming Stamina to move rapidly.

When under the effect of Illusory Torrent, Mona can move at high speed on water.
Applies the Wet status to nearby opponents when she reappears.

passives.name: "Come 'n' Get Me, Hag!"
passives.description:
After she has used Illusory Torrent for 2s, if there are any opponents nearby, Mona will automatically create a Phantom.
A Phantom created in this manner lasts for 2s, and its explosion DMG is equal to 50% of Mirror Reflection of Doom.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I am Astrologist Mona Megistus, meaning "The Great Astrologist Mona." If it is divination you seek from me, then I ask you respect my name by learning it wholly, here and now.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Astrology
voiceLines.description: Divination is about precisely foretelling one's written destiny. Over-embellishing that fate only leads to misconception.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Life
voiceLines.description: Astrologers must rid themselves of material desires. Only by ridding oneself of clutter can one see the true world around them.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Fate
voiceLines.description: Fate is called as such, for it cannot be changed, nor can it be reversed. It can only but be accepted.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: With rain this heavy, not only are the stars clouded, so too is my scryglass hazy.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Which of the starry skies do these thunderbolts fall from?

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: The pure waters of melted snow are optimal for hydromancy.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: One need not scry to know today's weather will be good.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Your arrival is untimely. The morning star has just waned... Breakfast? No, I—I've already eaten.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Noon is upon us, we should eat. Hm? I... I will have a salad, for simplicity is the way of the astrologer.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Nightfall has arrived. I will soon be able to begin my divination. Ah... Did I finish writing my astrology column last night...?

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: It's already so late, and I'm no further along on finishing tomorrow's astrology column. What? You're off to sleep? *sigh* I wish I could sleep now too...

voiceLines.title: About Mona
voiceLines.description: The work of the astrologer is to show people what fate has in store for them, and that's exactly what I do. There will always be those, however, who are unable to accept what they are told.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Work
voiceLines.description: Why do I write reports rather than using my divination to earn Mora? I would never use hydromancy for the sake of Mora, nor did I learn hydromancy for that purpose.

voiceLines.title: About Us: My Fate
voiceLines.description: I don't know. Unless left with no other choice, astrologers do not foretell their own fate. The elders of my art warned against it, for it can turn fate in on itself, which is incredibly dangerous.

name: Keqing
title: Driving Thunder
description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

Lightning Stiletto
 If Keqing uses Stellar Restoration again or uses a Charged Attack while its duration lasts, it will clear the Stiletto Mark and produce different effects:
·If she uses Stellar Restoration again, she will blink to the location of the Mark and unleash one slashing attack that deals AoE Electro DMG. When blinking to a Stiletto that was thrown from a Holding attack, Keqing can leap across obstructing terrain.
·If Keqing uses a Charged Attack, she will ignite a series of thundering cuts at the Mark's location, dealing AoE Electro DMG.

Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I am Keqing, Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. We live in an era of change, as the old order that has existed for a thousand years is about to be rewritten. Join me. Let us bear witness to this historical moment together.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Delays
voiceLines.description: Come on. Enough procrastinating. Let's go.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Relax
voiceLines.description: I'm all for work-life balance, but I think this is pushing it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Opportunity
voiceLines.description: In adventuring, as in business, you always have to seize the opportunity while it's there.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Quite a downpour... Nothing will get done until it clears. Let this be a lesson to those who yesterday said, "I'll do it tomorrow."

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Thunder and lightning can be quite frightening, but don't worry — Liyue's storm and fire defenses are second to none.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Don't worry, snowfall on this scale is no impediment. We can keep moving.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Ah, the sun is out. Our work's done for the day... shall we take a stroll?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning. Time to set the tone for the rest of the day, so if you're still feeling sleepy, shake it off!

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: I'm not in the habit of napping at noon, but don't let that stop you if you're feeling tired. I'll give you a wake-up call in, say, three minutes' time.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: The lights are coming on now that the night is setting in. *yawn* Another delightful day draws to a close.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Sleep well. ...Me? Uh... I still have a handful of things on my to-do list, but I'll call it a night once they're done.

voiceLines.title: About Keqing: Idealism
voiceLines.description: If you feel strongly about something, you should speak up and take action. That's the philosophy I live by.

voiceLines.title: About Keqing: Work
voiceLines.description: My role is to manage real estate and construction in Liyue. Sure, Liyue is a vast place with abundant resources — but without proper planning, and if too much focus is placed on short-term profit, a great many things can go wrong.

voiceLines.title: About Keqing: Skepticism
voiceLines.description: What do you think has kept Liyue going over the last millennium? Rex Lapis? ...I disagree. We mortals have to fight for survival whatever happens. He just feels the need to come down here and poke his nose into everything that's going on for some reason... Hmph, people don't like to think about this, but should we really be trusting him to be an expert in everything?

name: Sucrose
title: Harmless Sweetie
description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

fetter.title: Harmless Sweetie

skills.name: Wind Spirit Creation
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 attacks using Wind Spirits, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of her Wind Spirits, Sucrose plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.

skills.name: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308
skills.description: Creates a small Wind Spirit that pulls opponents and objects towards its location, launches opponents within its AoE, and deals Anemo DMG.

skills.name: Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II
skills.description:
Sucrose hurls an unstable concoction that creates a Large Wind Spirit.
While it persists, the Large Wind Spirit will continuously pull in surrounding opponents and objects, launch nearby opponents, and deal Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the Wind Spirit comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro energy, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

passives.name: Catalyst Conversion
passives.description: When Sucrose triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, all characters in the party with the matching element (excluding Sucrose) have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50 for 8s.

passives.name: Mollis Favonius
passives.description: When Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 or Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Sucrose) Elemental Mastery by an amount equal to 20% of Sucrose's Elemental Mastery for 8s.

passives.name: Astable Invention

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: I'm Sucrose, a researcher of alchemy. I heard you've been to a lot of places, so I was wondering if you... Ah, what am I saying! It's only our first time meeting, I shouldn't trouble you. But... if you're willing, I'd love to hear any stories you have about your adventures. I'd... really like that.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Curiosity
voiceLines.description: What was that? Oh... it's gone. Can I go take a look?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Organization
voiceLines.description: I just need a moment to quickly take down some notes.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Deep Breaths
voiceLines.description: Ahhh! I haven't been out in a while.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: The windmills are spinning faster than usual today. Hey, do you think if an animal put a propeller on its back and started running... do you think the propeller would make it run faster? Or even, fly?

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Snow this big only falls a few times a year. If I miss it, I'll have to wait until next year to run my experiments, so please give me some space. Ah-Ahchooo! ...Yes, I know, I should wear more layers...

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: The sun is already out? Oh, ah, okay! Just one last experiment, and then we can get some rest. Last one, I promise...

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Humidity levels are increasing. Think we could run some tests?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Good morning. Did you sleep well? According to research, not getting a good night's sleep can have detrimental effects on your cognition and stamina. What? I'm always up working through the night? Yeah, I know... Can't be helped I guess...

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Waaaaa! No, stay back, don't come over here! No, no, it's nothing personal — it's just that this experiment is highly volatile and might cause an explosion.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Good evening. Please wait a moment. Experiment 905 has actually produced two light excretions, which, for clarity's sake, should be labeled No. 1033 and No. 1035 respectively... Right, now, what did you need me for?

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: No need to wait up for me. Please, get some sleep. Something bothering you? Oh, don't worry about me — I'm right at the end of my experiment. I promise I won't stay up late again...

voiceLines.title: About Sucrose: Bio-Alchemy
voiceLines.description: Bio-alchemy, when compared with creation, places more emphasis on transformation. Finding those little secrets that living creatures have and scaling them up, combining them — the results are always such a surprise. Life really is fascinating. Just how much do we really know?

voiceLines.title: About Sucrose: Fear of Strangers
voiceLines.description: I... um... really don't know how to act around new people. Everyone's personality is different, as are the things they care about. If I slip up and say the wrong thing, I'll offend someone, or sound impolite... Talking is hard, so much harder than alchemy.

voiceLines.title: About Sucrose: Ears
voiceLines.description: Oh, you, ahh... noticed. My ears are a hereditary feature... quite different from everyone else's. So, I try to hide them with my hair as much as possible.

name: Xinyan
title: Blazing Riff
description: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

fetter.title: Blazing Riff
fetter.detail: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

skills.name: Dance on Fire
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Sweeping Fervor
skills.description:
Xinyan brandishes her instrument, dealing Pyro DMG on nearby opponents, forming a shield made out of her audience's passion.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Xinyan's DEF and on the number of opponents hit.
·Hitting 0–1 opponents grants Shield Level 1: Ad Lib.
·Hitting 2 opponents grants Shield Level 2: Lead-In.
·Hitting 3 or more opponents grants Shield Level 3: Rave, which will also deal intermittent Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.

The shield has the following special properties:
·When unleashed, it infuses Xinyan with Pyro.
·It has 250% DMG Absorption effectiveness against Pyro DMG.

skills.name: Riff Revolution
skills.description:
Strumming rapidly, Xinyan launches nearby opponents and deals Physical DMG to them, hyping up the crowd.
The sheer intensity of the atmosphere will cause explosions that deal Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.

passives.name: "The Show Goes On, Even Without an Audience..."
passives.description:
Decreases the number of opponents Sweeping Fervor must hit to trigger each level of shielding.
·Shield Level 2: Lead-In requirement reduced to 1 opponent hit.
·Shield Level 3: Rave requirement reduced to 2 opponents hit or more.

passives.name: "...Now That's Rock 'N' Roll!"
passives.description: Characters shielded by Sweeping Fervor deal 15% increased Physical DMG.

passives.name: A Rad Recipe
passives.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a DEF-boosting dish, Xinyan has a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

constellations.name: Fatal Acceleration

constellations.description: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Xinyan's Charged Attacks by 30%. Additionally, Xinyan's Charged Attacks gain an ATK Bonus equal to 50% of her DEF.
constellations.effect: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Xinyan's Charged Attacks by 30%. Additionally, Xinyan's Charged Attacks gain an ATK Bonus equal to 50% of her DEF.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Xinyan's the name, an' rock 'n' roll's the game — and I'm the only one who plays it in Liyue Harbor. Been thinking about staging concerts elsewhere lately, but... Hmm... Well, word is that you've been all over the place, Traveler. So, what say you sign me up for your world tour? Anywhere's good!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Vigor
voiceLines.description: If there's fire in your soul, you gotta rock 'n' roll. So c'mon! Let's get movin'!

voiceLines.title: Chat: New Song
voiceLines.description: I just came up with an awesome new riff, wanna hear it?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Look!
voiceLines.description: Whatever's going on over there... Looks pretty rock 'n' roll to me!

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: It's really comin' down... Would be all sorts of bad if my guitar got wet.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: This rain ain't clearin' any time soon... but the show's still on, people!

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Hmm... How do we attract more folks in this weather? Right! How about we stage a rock-till-you-drop snowstorm endurance challenge?

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Ack! Gotta find some cover, quick, or my hairdo's gonna fall apart!

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Mornin'! I was just warmin' my voice up. We're in real good shape today.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Alright, that's a wrap! *yawns* If there's nothin' else, I'll go take a nap somewhere...

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Almost about to go live over here. You comin'?

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Me? Oh, I've got a guitar to maintain, tunes to rewrite... I mean, I just got offstage, there's no way I can sleep right now.

voiceLines.title: About Xinyan: Frightening
voiceLines.description: Not afraid of me, are you? Some folks say I've got eyes like knives, that I don't wear my clothes right, that I don't speak right. They give me a pretty wide berth, too. Really, can't a girl sport her own style without bein' looked at like she's some weird creature outta who-knows-where?

voiceLines.title: About Xinyan: Rock 'N' Roll
voiceLines.description: Rock 'n' roll came to Liyue from Fontaine, so I guess you could call it a new thing. But it's not too hot around here. Most think it's an awful racket not fit for human ears. And that's why I appreciate everyone who does come listen, haha!

voiceLines.title: About Us: The Audience
voiceLines.description: You wanna hear me play? Come to the front — it sounds best from there! *clears throat* Alright then, comin' at you from the one and only rock stage in Liyue!

name: Rosaria
title: Thorny Benevolence
description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

fetter.title: Thorny Benevolence
fetter.detail: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

skills.name: Spear of the Church
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Ravaging Confession
skills.description:
Rosaria swiftly shifts her position to appear behind her opponent, then stabs and slashes them with her polearm, dealing Cryo DMG.
This ability cannot be used to travel behind opponents of a larger build.

skills.name: Rites of Termination
skills.description:
Rosaria's unique take on this prayer ritual: First, she swings her weapon to slash surrounding opponents; then, she summons a frigid Ice Lance that strikes the ground. Both actions deal Cryo DMG.
While active, the Ice Lance periodically releases a blast of cold air, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.

passives.name: Regina Probationum
passives.description: When Rosaria strikes an opponent from behind using Ravaging Confession, Rosaria's CRIT Rate increases by 12% for 5s.

passives.name: Shadow Samaritan
passives.description:
Casting Rites of Termination increases CRIT Rate of all nearby party members (except Rosaria herself) by 15% of Rosaria's CRIT Rate for 10s.
CRIT Rate Bonus gained this way cannot exceed 15%.

passives.name: Night Walk
passives.description:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.

constellations.name: Unholy Revelation
constellations.description: When Rosaria deals a CRIT Hit, her ATK SPD increases by 10% and her Normal Attack DMG increases by 10% for 4s.
constellations.effect: When Rosaria deals a CRIT Hit, her ATK SPD increases by 10% and her Normal Attack DMG increases by 10% for 4s.

constellations.effect: The duration of the Ice Lance created by Rites of Termination is increased by 4s.

constellations.effect: Rites of Termination's attack decreases opponents' Physical RES by 20% for 10s.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description:
Listen disciple, if you've got a problem you can't handle, then I'm the one for the job. But if you're looking for prayer, you'd better find some other Sister
...Huh? You're not a disciple?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Boredom
voiceLines.description: Don't we have a job to do?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Overtime
voiceLines.description: Everything is negotiable, except overtime.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Life in Mondstadt
voiceLines.description: Work hard and live each day to the fullest. That is what life in Mondstadt is all about, isn't it?

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: This will slow things down.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: ...What a nuisance.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: We should keep moving, but watch your step in the snow.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: Blessings from the Anemo Archon Barsibato? Wait... no, it's Bartobas...?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: *yawn* Good morning... I've missed morning mass, haven't I? Ugh, it starts too early anyway.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: I'd say I sleep even better in the afternoon sun. You should try it sometime.

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Good evening. Don't expect to see me at prayer tonight... And don't ask why.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Go ahead, take a break. I'll handle things here.

voiceLines.title: About Rosaria: Sister
voiceLines.description: Me? I'm just another ordinary person. Church, work... I just do what I have to do.

voiceLines.title: About Rosaria: Troubles
voiceLines.description: Each of the Sisters is worse than the next. If it's not about prayer, then it's about choir or some other thing I'm supposed to participate in... I'm trying to stay out of sight, so don't you dare tell them you saw me here.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Beliefs
voiceLines.description: Perhaps a god has the power to protect everyone if they would choose to do so, but that would never happen. Otherwise, people's suffering couldn't ever be taken seriously.

name: Hu Tao
title: Fragrance in Thaw
description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

fetter.title: Fragrance in Thaw
fetter.detail: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

skills.name: Secret Spear of Wangsheng
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack

skills.name: Guide to Afterlife
skills.description:
Only an unwavering flame can cleanse the impurities of this world.
Hu Tao consumes a set portion of her HP to knock the surrounding enemies back and enter the Paramita Papilio state.

Paramita Papilio
·Increases Hu Tao's ATK based on her Max HP at the time of entering this state. ATK Bonus gained this way cannot exceed 400% of Hu Tao's Base ATK.
·Converts attack DMG to Pyro DMG, which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Charged Attacks apply the Blood Blossom effect to the enemies hit.
·Increases Hu Tao's resistance to interruption.

Blood Blossom
Enemies affected by Blood Blossom will take Pyro DMG every 4s. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Each enemy can be affected by only one Blood Blossom effect at a time, and its duration may only be refreshed by Hu Tao herself.

Paramita Papilio ends when its duration is over, or Hu Tao has left the battlefield or fallen.

skills.name: Spirit Soother
skills.description:
Commands a blazing spirit to attack, dealing Pyro DMG in a large AoE.
Upon striking the enemy, regenerates a percentage of Hu Tao's Max HP. This effect can be triggered up to 5 times, based on the number of enemies hit.
If Hu Tao's HP is below or equal to 50% when the enemy is hit, both the DMG and HP Regeneration are increased.

passives.name: Flutter By
passives.description: When a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife ends, all allies in the party (excluding Hu Tao herself) will have their CRIT Rate increased by 12% for 8s.

passives.name: Sanguine Rouge
passives.description: When Hu Tao's HP is equal to or less than 50%, her Pyro DMG Bonus is increased by 33%.

passives.name: The More the Merrier
passives.description: When Hu Tao cooks a dish perfectly, she has an 18% chance to receive an additional "Suspicious" dish of the same type.

constellations.name: Crimson Bouquet
constellations.description: While in a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife, Hu Tao's Charged Attacks do not consume Stamina.
constellations.effect: While in a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife, Hu Tao's Charged Attacks do not consume Stamina.

constellations.name: Ominous Rainfall
constellations.description:
Increases the Blood Blossom DMG by an amount equal to 10% of Hu Tao's Max HP at the time the effect is applied.
Additionally, Spirit Soother will also apply the Blood Blossom effect.
constellations.effect:

Hu Tao will not fall as a result of the DMG sustained. Additionally, for the next 10s, her All Elemental and Physical RES is increased by 200%, her CRIT Rate is increased by 100%, and her resistance to interruption is greatly increased.

Can only occur once every 60s.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Yoh, now why might you be looking for me, hm? Oh, you didn't know? I'm the 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, Hu Tao. Though by the looks of you... Radiant glow, healthy posture... Yes, you're definitely here for something other than that which falls within my regular line of work, aren't you?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
voiceLines.description: Wanna come over for tea?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Customers
voiceLines.description: One client, two clients, three clients!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Taking a Break
voiceLines.description: When the sun's out, bathe in sunlight. But when the moon's out, bathe in moonlight~

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: *sigh* What a bummer...

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Lightning! Let's bolt!

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Snow!

voiceLines.title: When It's Windy
voiceLines.description: Ahhhh~ What a nice breeze~

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: My hat's gonna get blown away!

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Well are those who rise in the early morn, while those late to bed I shall forewarn~

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Yo! Afternoon! Had lunch?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Hee-hee, moon's out, and so am I!

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Oh, you sleepy? Get some rest, I'm gonna take a walk by myself...

voiceLines.title: About Hu Tao: Name
voiceLines.description: Hu as in "Who put me in this coffin?" and Tao as in "I can't geT OUt!" Hehe... No, not funny?

voiceLines.title: About Hu Tao: Favorite Tricks
voiceLines.description: Lemme show you some fire tricks. First... Fire! And then... Whoosh! Fire butterfly! Be free!

name: Kaedehara Kazuha

description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

Charged Attack

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact. If this Plunging Attack is triggered by Chihayaburu, it will be converted to Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan.

Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan
When a Plunging Attack is performed using the effects of the Elemental Skill Chihayaburu, Plunging Attack DMG is converted to Anemo DMG and will create a small wind tunnel via a secret blade technique that pulls in nearby objects and opponents.

skills.name: Chihayaburu
skills.description:
Unleashes a secret technique as fierce as the rushing wind that pulls objects and opponents towards Kazuha's current position before launching opponents within the AoE, dealing Anemo DMG and lifting Kazuha into the air on a rushing gust of wind.
Within 10s of remaining airborne after casting Chihayaburu, Kazuha can unleash a powerful Plunging Attack known as Midare Ranzan.

Press
Can be used in mid-air.

Hold
Charges up before unleashing greater Anemo DMG over a larger AoE than Press Mode.

Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan
When a Plunging Attack is performed using the effects of the Elemental Skill Chihayaburu, Plunging Attack DMG is converted to Anemo DMG. On landing, Kazuha creates a small wind tunnel via a secret blade technique that pulls in nearby objects and opponents.
Midare Ranzan's DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.

skills.name: Kazuha Slash
skills.description:

The blade's passage will leave behind a field named "Autumn Whirlwind" that periodically deals AoE Anemo DMG to opponents within its range.

Elemental Absorption

Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

This will be considered Plunging Attack DMG.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use of Chihayaburu.

passives.name: Poetics of Fuubutsu

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: "Come driving rain or winds that churn, I shall return, by blade alone, armed, if barefoot, to my home..." I am Kaedehara Kazuha, a wanderer who roams the land. Since we are both travelers, let us journey together for a time.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Nature
voiceLines.description: This scenery is wonderful... Surely enough to convince anyone to become a wanderer.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Playing a Tune
voiceLines.description: There are leaves around — and I know just the tune to accompany them, if you wish to hear it.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Bladework
voiceLines.description: Wherever in this world I roam, I carry memories of my home... This blade... It is the last link I have to the land of my birth.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Taking a stroll in the middle of a downpour certainly rouses the spirit... but it's best to dry your clothes as soon as possible after the rain stops.

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: Compared to the storms I've encountered out at sea, this is really quite tame.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: I love it when it snows. The world falls completely silent... and I can sleep undisturbed.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Clear weather all around brightens the heart.

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: The birdsong at daybreak is nature's gift to us. Let us go. Our journey begins anew.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: ...The midday sun has a way of making one yearn for a moment of sleep. What say we find ourselves a place to rest?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: I gaze up at the moon and lend my ear to the gentle breeze, with wine in my cup and peace in my heart... Have a wonderful evening.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: The wind has ceased... The world is silent, so now is the best time to rest well. See you tomorrow.

voiceLines.title: About Kaedehara Kazuha: Sailing
voiceLines.description: In truth, not every night out at sea is filled with wind and waves. When the weather is clear, the moonlight flows over the rippling water, and schools of fish circle the ship's hull. At moments like that, when I look out into the distance from the prow, I feel like this journey is worth it... The only thing that takes away from that feeling is the sailors' singing. They're so loud... don't they need to sleep?

voiceLines.title: About Kaedehara Kazuha: Samurai Nobility
voiceLines.description: The Kaedehara Clan was once a famed samurai clan. It's a pity that by the time the noble name passed to me, the title itself was all that was left. But it is enough for me. A samurai has no need of a lavish life — we find all that we need in wine, song, and the blade in our hands.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Going Out to Sea
voiceLines.description: What say you join me out at sea someday when the weather's fine?

Each Scarlet Seal will decrease Yanfei's Stamina consumption and will disappear when she leaves the field.

Charged Attack
Consumes Stamina and all Scarlet Seals before dealing AoE Pyro DMG to opponents after a short casting time.
This Charged Attack's AoE and DMG will increase according to the amount of Scarlet Seals consumed.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the power of Pyro, Yanfei plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.

skills.description:

skills.name: Done Deal

·Increases the DMG dealt by her Charged Attacks.
The effects of Brilliance will end if Yanfei leaves the field or falls in battle.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: My name is Yanfei, top legal expert in Liyue — and for the avoidance of doubt, no one else comes close! From commercial litigation, to civil mediation, to criminal lawsuits, I'm fully versed in every area of the law, and I guarantee you a swift and satisfactory conclusion to your case! My contact details... Where should I write this down? ...Hmm, paper will just get lost, and it'll only rub off if I write it on the back of your hand, so... Aha! I know, I'll just write it here, on the clothes of this... whatever this thing is that follows you around.

voiceLines.title: Chat: The Law
voiceLines.description: I'll remind you again: The law can be both a help and a hindrance.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Work
voiceLines.description: Sometimes the law is compatible with human nature, but sometimes the two conflict. Balancing the two is a discipline in its own right...

voiceLines.title: Chat: Reading
voiceLines.description: The case before us... is a strange and unprecedented one indeed.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Rain! Oh, Lord of Geo, please, do us a favor and clear this up at your earliest convenience... I submit that we cannot afford for the codices to get damp...

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: What the... What kind of injurious weather is this!? It's c—cold... Achoo...

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Ah, this weather's got me in the mood for reciting some laws. Let's see... "Commercial Law of Liyue," Chapter 27, Section 6, Article 3 stipulates that— Wait, what was it...? Oh my goodness, I've completely forgotten! What is wrong with me today...?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: I have to head out this morning to meet a client about a creditor dispute, but I also have to follow up on a consultation from last week by noon... Alright, time to get to work!

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: *yawn* I'm a little sleepy... I know, a vigorous debate should wake me up! And I've got just the topic: "The Northland Bank's presence in Liyue does more harm than good for our economy." ...So, are you for or against?

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description:
The night market? Hmm... I was planning on organizing some files this evening, but if you're going, I can join you. Oh, I should mention — lots of vendors go for the hard sell in the evenings, because they want to be able to start with fresh produce the next day, but also don't want to lose profit on what they have left today.
So, leave the negotiating to me. And... If you have any leftovers, those can be my fee.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Need a cure for insomnia? Let me read you the history of the development of Liyue's legal system! None of my friends have ever lasted longer than 20 minutes... Oh, you want something more fast-acting? Then I'll recite from the legal codices! Let me know in the morning which section I got to before you fell asleep! Okay, here I go...

voiceLines.title: About Yanfei: Atmosphere
voiceLines.description: You think I come across as quite imposing when I'm reading through case files? Huh. Well, that's only when I'm in work mode. It's like... I have an invisible switch, flick it one way and I'm in normal mode, flick it the other way and I switch to work mode. Surely you must have a switch like that, too?

voiceLines.title: About Yanfei: Weakness
voiceLines.description: Civil cases are the ones I dread the most. Divorces, custody disputes... It's a thankless task trying to unpack these kinds of cases with logic and reason. You have to be kind, courteous, and patient with your clients, even though half the time they are completely incapable of participating in a constructive discussion. *sigh* I know I advertise myself as being fully versed in every area of the law, but honestly, if it were up to me, I'd rather everyone could just get along, so we wouldn't have so many of these cases.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Rates
voiceLines.description: You want legal advice from me? Sure. For legal opinions, I charge a flat rate of 6,000 Mora, for advisory services, my hourly rate is 180,000 Mora, and for commercial law, I charge 710,000 Mora per case — final quote and commission rate depending on the details of your case. Not a bad deal, right?

voiceLines.title: About Us: Relationships
voiceLines.description: If you're concerned about what kind of complicated issues you might get tied up in during your travels, your best bet is to bring someone with you who knows and understands the law. Someone like me, for example, whose expertise goes beyond just the law of Liyue... Well, actually, having said that, Fontaine's law is notoriously complicated... Though, with my level of intelligence, getting acquainted with it should be no problem! Anyway... My point is, you can always rely on me!

name: Yoimiya

description: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

Normal Attack

Charged Attack

While aiming, flames will accumulate on the arrowhead before being fired off as an attack. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off a flaming arrow that deals Pyro DMG.
·Charge Level 2: Generates a maximum of 3 Kindling Arrows based on time spent charging, releasing them as part of this Aimed Shot. Kindling Arrows will home in on nearby opponents, dealing Pyro DMG on hit.

Plunging Attack

Niwabi Enshou

skills.name: Ryuukin Saxifrage
skills.description:
Yoimiya leaps into the air along with her original creation, the "Ryuukin Saxifrage," and fires forth blazing rockets bursting with surprises that deal AoE Pyro DMG and mark one of the hit opponents with Aurous Blaze.

Aurous Blaze
All Normal/Charged/Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts by any party member other than Yoimiya that hit an opponent marked by Aurous Blaze will trigger an explosion, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
When an opponent affected by Aurous Blaze is defeated before its duration expires, the effect will pass on to another nearby opponent, who will inherit the remaining duration.

One Aurous Blaze explosion can be triggered every 2s. When Yoimiya is down, Aurous Blaze effects created through her skills will be deactivated.

passives.name: Tricks of the Trouble-Maker

Additionally, a further ATK Bonus will be added on based on the number of Ascension Talent "Tricks of the Trouble-Maker" stacks Yoimiya possesses when using Ryuukin Saxifrage. Each stack increases this ATK Bonus by 1%.

passives.name: Blazing Match

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: Welcome to Naganohara! My name is Yoimiya — just let me know if you need anything! We have Kushikatsu, Egg Roll... Wait, no, we're not a restaurant. We make fireworks! Like these, see? Sparkling, crackling, little fireworks~

voiceLines.title: Chat: Fireworks
voiceLines.description: Fireworks are for now, but friends are forever.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Telling Stories
voiceLines.description: If we've got nothing else to do, why don't I tell you a story?

voiceLines.title: Chat: Goldfish
voiceLines.description: Have you ever kept goldfish as pets? They're very cute.

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Ahh, the fireworks are going to get soaked! Let's find shelter, quick! Oh, we're not going to make it!

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Haha, watch me make a snowball... pew!

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Ah, this is great! I feel so relaxed all over, I could almost float away.

voiceLines.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voiceLines.description: The wind's so strong—! It's blowing my voice back at me—! Hahaha...

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Ah... *yawns* Good morning. The morning air is the freshest. Come on, take a few extra breaths — it'll make you smarter~

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: Time for lunch! ... Oh my, it's an egg with a double yolk. What wonderful luck!

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Now's the best time to test our fireworks out, though I'm sure they'll look good whether they explode in the sky or on the ground... Hehe, just kidding. I'll pay attention to safety.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Question time! So, what should you do after watching fireworks all day? Hehe, the answer is... to watch them again in your dreams, of course! Good night. See you tomorrow!

voiceLines.title: About Yoimiya: Family Matters
voiceLines.description: My father's hearing isn't very good. When I was young, he would always smile no matter what I said to him, and so I thought that everything I said was correct. So I kept talking, and he would keep smiling. Later, I found out that he was smiling because he couldn't hear clearly, but... as long as he's truly happy, I'll keep talking to him.

voiceLines.title: About Yoimiya: Talking
voiceLines.description: I don't worry about "loose lips sinking ships." The emotions contained in the words people say don't lie. Misunderstandings that arise from saying things wrongly can be resolved if you just talk more, but if you say nothing, the other person won't understand what you mean, and they can't get closer to you.

voiceLines.title: About Us: Rock, Paper, Scissors
voiceLines.description: Let's have a game of rock paper scissors! On my count, now — rock, paper, scissors! Woohoo, I won! I won! ... Hmm? I didn't change my choice halfway. Why would I ever do that?

The maximum DMG Absorption of the Blazing Barrier will not exceed a certain percentage of Thoma's Max HP.

Thoma spins his polearm, slicing at his foes with roaring flames that deal AoE Pyro DMG and weave themselves into a Scorching Ooyoroi.

Scorching Ooyoroi
While Scorching Ooyoroi is in effect, the active character's Normal Attacks will trigger Fiery Collapse, dealing AoE Pyro DMG and summoning a Blazing Barrier.
Fiery Collapse can be triggered once every 1s.

Except for the amount of DMG they can absorb, the Blazing Barriers created in this way are identical to those created by Thoma's Elemental Skill, Blazing Blessing:
·Absorbs Pyro DMG 250% more effectively.
·When a new Blazing Barrier is obtained, the remaining DMG Absorption of an existing Blazing Barrier will stack and its duration will be refreshed.

The maximum DMG Absorption of the Blazing Barrier will not exceed a certain percentage of Thoma's Max HP.

If Thoma falls, the effects of Scorching Ooyoroi will be cleared.

voiceLines.title: Hello
voiceLines.description: It's good to meet you at last, Traveler. I've been hearing about you for a long time now. I'm your new buddy, Thoma — as long as that's okay with you, of course!

voiceLines.title: Chat: Thoma's Treat
voiceLines.description: Hey... how about we go for a nice meal some time? My treat, of course.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Concern
voiceLines.description: I feel like there's something I forgot to do... hmm, I tidied the courtyard, put the tea on... Eh, it's probably just my mind playing tricks on me.

voiceLines.title: Chat: Mora
voiceLines.description: I really did spend a lot recently, only 10 Mora left... Still, 10 Mora's better than no Mora!

voiceLines.title: When It Rains
voiceLines.description: Where'd this rain come from? Are you gonna be okay? Here, I'll lend you my coat...

voiceLines.title: When Thunder Strikes
voiceLines.description: You don't wanna be out in open country in this kind of weather. You'll get struck by lightning for sure.

voiceLines.title: When It Snows
voiceLines.description: Don't run on the ice... 'cause if you fall down, I won't help you up, you gotta learn somehow.

voiceLines.title: When the Sun Is Out
voiceLines.description: Lovely weather we're having! Will you join me for a walk?

voiceLines.title: Good Morning
voiceLines.description: Morning! If you're free, why not come with me to the market? The vegetables are freshest earlier in the day.

voiceLines.title: Good Afternoon
voiceLines.description: On the lunch menu today, we have Sakura Tempura and Tricolor Dango! Here, there's some for you, some for Paimon, and I also put some aside for milady and the man of the clan himself. Ah, wait, I forgot someone... There's none for me...

voiceLines.title: Good Evening
voiceLines.description: Come quick, we gotta get down to the market — they slash the prices on fish around this time of day. Oh, and if you find something that you just can't do without, I'll help you haggle the price down.

voiceLines.title: Good Night
voiceLines.description: Okay, good night. You had a busy day today, you should get some rest, too. Don't stay up too late.

voiceLines.title: About Thoma: Housekeeper
voiceLines.description: It was never Ayaka or Ayato's intention to make me the housekeeper, I volunteered. I like this kind of work. Putting everything in order gives me a great sense of achievement, and based on everyone's reactions... Yeah, I think I do a pretty good job.

voiceLines.title: About Thoma: Meaning
voiceLines.description: For me, housework is about keeping a space clean and tidy, so that everyone who lives there has a smile on their face. And now... it looks like I'm responsible for another smile. I'll do my best to deliver!

voiceLines.title: About Us: Eating Alone
voiceLines.description: Hey, how come you're eating here all alone? ...Uh, is it okay if I join you? Or did you just want some space?

name: Eula
title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Icetide Vortex
skills.description:
Sharp frost, swift blade.

Press
Slashes swiftly, dealing Cryo DMG.
When it hits an opponent, Eula gains a stack of Grimheart that stacks up to 2 times. These stacks can only be gained once every 0.3s.

Grimheart
Increases Eula's resistance to interruption and DEF.

Hold
Wielding her sword, Eula consumes all the stacks of Grimheart and lashes forward, dealing AoE Cryo DMG to opponents in front of her.
If Grimheart stacks are consumed, surrounding opponents will have their Physical RES and Cryo RES decreased.
Each consumed stack of Grimheart will be converted into an Icewhirl Brand that deals Cryo DMG to nearby opponents.

skills.name: Glacial Illumination
skills.description:
Brandishes her greatsword, dealing Cryo DMG to nearby opponents and creating a Lightfall Sword that follows her around for a duration of up to 7s.
While present, the Lightfall Sword increases Eula's resistance to interruption. When Eula's own Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst deal DMG to opponents, they will charge the Lightfall Sword, which can gain an energy stack once every 0.1s.
Once its duration ends, the Lightfall Sword will descend and explode violently, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
This DMG scales on the number of energy stacks the Lightfall Sword has accumulated.
If Eula leaves the field, the Lightfall Sword will explode immediately.

passives.name: Roiling Rime
passives.description: If 2 stacks of Grimheart are consumed upon unleashing the Holding Mode of Icetide Vortex, a Shattered Lightfall Sword will be created that will explode immediately, dealing 50% of the basic Physical DMG dealt by a Lightfall Sword created by Glacial Illumination.

passives.name: Wellspring of War-Lust
passives.description: When Glacial Illumination is cast, the CD of Icetide Vortex is reset and Eula gains 1 stack of Grimheart.

passives.name: Aristocratic Introspection
passives.description: When Eula crafts Character Talent Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

Each stack consumed will increase the duration of this effect by 6s up to a maximum of 18s.
